title: Glory
summary:
Glory is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language sports thriller television series written and directed by Karan Anshuman and Kanishk Varma for Netflix. The series is produced by Karan Anshuman and Mohit Shah of Atomic Films. It stars Divyenndu, Pulkit Samrat and Suvinder Vicky as pivotal role.
The series was filmed mostly across Haryana. John Schmidt served as the cinematographer of the series. John Stewart Eduri composed the background score. 
The first season of Glory was released on 1 May 2026.
plot: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.
reception:
Anuj Kumar for The Hindu stated the series "a cohesive whole for viewers attuned to logical consistency and tonal balance."
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express rated the series 2/5 stars and raised concern about violence shown stating "Animals aren’t spared either."
Joel Keller of Decider stated the series as "it’s a pretty dark and violent story." Bhavna Agarwal of India Today wrote "The idea is strong: use a whodunit to peel back emotional layers. And initially, it works."
Suchin Mehrotra of The Hollywood Reporter India stated "shamelessly pulpy crime drama in recent memory — emotionally potent, generically promiscuous, and rich with festering old wounds." Udita Jhunjhunwala for Scroll.in felt the violence is extreme." BH Harsh of Cinema Express praised Divyenndu's performance and wrote "Divyenndu delivers a stellar performance."
Abhimanyu Mathur Hindustan Times stated "Glory is a good example of ‘what could have been’, which has been the story of Indian OTT since the pandemic." Bollywood Hungama rated the series 3 stars in their review.
Shachi Chaturvedi from News18 stated "the narrative could have benefited from tighter storytelling."

episodesList.title: K.O.
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh after years away, pulled back by the brutal assault on their sister Gudiya. The Catalyst lands hard in the family home as they confront their father Raghubir, whose rigid boxing obsession has hollowed their past relationship. Tension tightens as the brothers begin tracing the attackers through the local boxing circuit. As Collision approaches, old grief over Nihal Singh's mysterious death resurfaces, turning suspicion inward across the town. A Moral Pivot forces Dev and Ravi to lean into rage and instinct, risking their remaining family bonds as the search grows more dangerous.

episodesList.title: Counterpunch
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: The brothers join forces in their search for vengeance. After returning to the scene of the crime, they stumble upon key evidence.

episodesList.title: Sparring Partner
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: A suspect's death leads to questions as Dev confronts Joyna. Raka seeks support elsewhere, while the rival boxing clubs prepare for an emergency trial.

episodesList.title: Rope-a-Dope
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: Ravi begins his training — and uses a surprise inspection to coerce a confession. Kookie toys with life and death, unleashing his wrath on Dev.

episodesList.title: Low Blow
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: Dev and Ravi's infiltration into a dangerous hideout turns explosive. A violent interrogation leads to an unexpected run from the law.

episodesList.title: Underdog
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: After breaking the rules, Ravi pleads his case ahead of the Olympic trials. Dev and Joyna search for clues and Arvind spirals after a shocking find.

episodesList.title: Suckerpunch
episodesList.writer: Karmanya Ahuja, Karan Anshuman, and Vaibhav Vishal
episodesList.summary: As the truth emerges, Dev must escape danger at every turn. Ravi claws his way to the final to face an old nemesis, but an attack may threaten his rise.

soundtrack.composer: The music composer John Stewart, who are frequent collaborators of Karan Anshuman, composed music for the series. He composed two songs, "Glory Title Track" and "Do Shera". Sez on the Beat composed two songs, "Aaya Jung Mein" and "Baat Baat Pe". A soundtrack album comprising six songs was released by T-Series on 27 April 2026.

title: Gharwali Pedwali
summary: Gharwali Pedwali is an Indian television series produced by Peninsula Pictures that aired on 5 December 2025 to 29 May 2026 on &TV and ZEE5. It stars Paras Arora, Seerat Kapoor, and Priyamvada Kant.
plot: Jeetu is raised by two sets of parents. He has everything doubled in his life, including two mothers, two fathers, and two bosses. Now, destiny gives him two wives. Jeetu wants a simple, devoted wife, but just before his marriage, an astrologer tells him for a symbolic marriage with a tree that turned into a spirit named Latika, who believes that she is Jeetu’s real wife. Now, Jeetu is caught between his actual wife, Savi, and Latika. What will he do now?

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: In July 2025, &TV announced a new series titled Gharwali Pedwali.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Paras Arora was confirmed to play Jeetu Pandey. Neeharika Roy was first approached for Savi but was replaced by Seerat Kapoor. Priyamvada Kant was selected to play Latika.

episodesList.title: Double Chaos In Jeetu's Life
episodesList.summary: Cursed by number 2, Jeetu faces everything, including chaos, in doubles. Before marrying Savi, Pandit Mama warns he’s destined for two weddings. During a tree marriage, something shocking awaits.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Collapses Seeing Two Brides
episodesList.summary: Jeetu’s tree marriage backfires as ghost bride Latika rises at midnight, claiming to be his first wife. She follows him home, appears on his nuptial night, and Jeetu collapses seeing two brides.

episodesList.title: Savi Grills Jeetu Over Latika
episodesList.summary: A jealous Savi grills Jeetu after he says ‘Latika’, unaware the ghost bride from the banyan tree has followed him home. As both wives attempt their rituals, Jeetu flees to break the haunting curse.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Panics After Seeing a Chaotic Dream
episodesList.summary: After a chaotic dream where Latika exposes herself as his ghost-wife, Jeetu panics. He attempts to cut the banyan tree, but Latika stops him, leaving Jeetu desperate for a permanent solution.

episodesList.title: A Furious Latika Creates Havoc
episodesList.summary: Latika gets jealous when Savi gets the credit for saving Dadaji. Puppy’s anti-ghost thread fails as Latika storms in, wrecks the cot and ruins Jeetu’s nuptial night, warning him of dire consequences.

episodesList.title: Latika's Revelation Scares Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Seeing the broken bed, the family assumes Jeetu and Savi spent their wedding night together. When Latika reveals she can be seen, Jeetu panics. Later, Savi finds lipstick marks on Jeetu’s shirt.

episodesList.title: Latika Threatens to Reveal Herself
episodesList.summary: Savi claims Jeetu has another woman in his life, causing chaos. Latika threatens to reveal herself, but Jeetu stops her at the last moment by showing a video of Puppy about to burn her sacred tree.

episodesList.title: Latika's Brother Lattu Saves The Tree
episodesList.summary: A few kids burst crackers near the petrol-soaked tree, and it goes up in flames. Latika’s brother Lattu causes sudden rain to douse the fire and later decides to make Jeetu pay for having two wives.

episodesList.title: Lattu's Magic Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: Lattu’s magic wreaks havoc, and Jeetu is left on the street. Later, possessed by Lattu, Dada Ji dances, and chaos erupts. Meanwhile, Puppy brings Dr Dang, giving Jeetu hope to trap Latika.

episodesList.title: Savi And Latika Fast For Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Jeetu and Puppy secretly call Dr Dang to catch the ghost. Meanwhile, Savi and Latika fast for Jeetu. Later, Dr Dang is summoned for Dadaji, while Latika teases Saavi to break her fast.

episodesList.title: Dr Dang's Radar Wrongly Tracks Lattu
episodesList.summary: Dr Dang secretly hunts the ghost using his radar, which wrongly tracks Lattu, and Jeetu realises Latika is outside. When Jeetu calls her name, Dr Dang discovers the ghost is hiding in a tree.

episodesList.title: Dadaji Witnesses Latika's Truth
episodesList.summary: Dr Dang attacks Latika, who later uses her magic, just as Dadaji witnesses the shocking truth. Savi’s attempt to make pakodas goes wrong when Lattu changes the video.

episodesList.title: Jeetu’s Plan to Outsmart Latika
episodesList.summary: Dadaji is stunned seeing a rooster on a swing. Meanwhile, Jeetu secretly plans a film outing with Saavi, seeks Pappi’s help, and even pretends to be ill before Latika.

episodesList.title: Latika Rages After Discovering Jeetu’s Deceit
episodesList.summary: Jeetu tricks Latika and goes for a movie with Saavi. Furious, Latika punishes Pappi for helping him and storms to the theatre. However, Pappi warns Jeetu with a call, leaving him anxious.

episodesList.title: Latika Reaches The Cinema And Confronts Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Latika confronts Jeetu at the theatre over betrayal. With Dadaji missing, the family suspects that he’s eloped with a neighbour. Later, Jeetu, Saavi and Latika unite to teach thugs a tough lesson.

episodesList.title: Latika And Saavi Drag Jeetu Into New Trouble
episodesList.summary: Latika’s spirit appears before Trivedi as Jeetu’s wife to protect his job. Saavi invites Dwivedi to dinner, plunging Jeetu into fresh trouble and leading him to seek help from Eknath and Pappi.

episodesList.title: Jeetu is Forced to Invite His Bosses For a Meal
episodesList.summary: Jeetu stages a drama to avoid inviting Dwivedi and Trivedi to for a meal but fails. Later, he hatches a plan, offering gifts to Latika and Saavi in a bid to win their favour.

episodesList.title: Trivedi and Dwivedi Come to Jeetu’s House
episodesList.summary: Rita and Geeta unknowingly take Latika into the kitchen, where she cooks the entire meal. Later, Trivedi and Dwivedi visit Jeetu’s home, but as Jeetu brings Saavi for 'Muh Dikhai', trouble strikes!

episodesList.title: Trivedi and Dwivedi Grow Suspicious Of Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Jeetu somehow completes the Muh Dikhai ritual, concealing the truth about his two wives from Trivedi and Dwivedi. Later, they grow suspicious, but Latika steps in to help!

episodesList.title: Jeetu is Troubled By Lattu
episodesList.summary: Lattu possesses Trivedi, and Jeetu slaps him. While trying to cure Ramesh and Suresh’s alcohol addiction, Lattu upsets Jeetu and later uses magic to twist his arm when Jeetu loses his temper.

episodesList.title: Lattu’s Playful Mischief With Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Lattu’s prank leaves Jeetu stiff‑limbed, making the family laugh. Though Lattu helps him recover, Jeetu refuses to accept him as his brother‑in‑law. Later, Jeetu calms the upset Trivedi and Dwivedi.

episodesList.title: Saavi Decides to Leave The House
episodesList.summary: Saavi is tasked with making Sankranti laddoos, but she gets into a clash with Jeetu because of Latika. To escape the burden, Saavi decides to leave home, leaving Jeetu stunned by her words.

episodesList.title: Buaji Sees Latika's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Jeetu stops Saavi from leaving home and helps her make laddoos. But when Latika’s spirit swoops in to snatch the tray, Buaji suddenly arrives and catches sight of her!

episodesList.title: Latika’s Rangoli Brings Trouble For Jeetu
episodesList.summary: On Makar Sankranti, Latika decorates the home and creates a rangoli featuring herself and Jeetu. Soon, the family confronts Jeetu, compelling him to lie to them and Saavi.

episodesList.title: Latika’s Stubbornness and Jeetu’s Ploy
episodesList.summary: Latika forcibly starts the Makar Sankranti puja and to prevent the truth from coming out, Jeetu distracts everyone. He then makes an excuse to stop everyone from eating the laddoos made by Saavi.

episodesList.title: Latika’s Sacrifice For Saavi
episodesList.summary: Latika offers Jeetu her homemade laddus and asks him to uphold Saavi’s honour. A distressed Saavi reveals the truth to her family. Lattu pranks Jeetu again, while Saavi’s modern look stuns Geeta.

episodesList.title: Latika Creates a Rift Between Saavi and Jeetu
episodesList.summary: At Latika’s urging, Lattu fixes Jeetu’s hair. Later, Latika’s fear keeps him from getting close to Saavi, who soon feels deeply hurt when Jeetu and the family forget her birthday.

episodesList.title: Saavi Observes a Vow Of Silence On Her Birthday
episodesList.summary: Mamaji wishes Saavi on her birthday and asks her to keep a vow of silence. Later, Latika tells Jeetu about a gift, leaving him anxious that Saavi might discover it.

episodesList.title: Saavi’s Vow Of Silence Forces Her to Flee Home
episodesList.summary: Saavi, bound by her vow of silence, avoids speaking to her family and flees home. The family is left shocked, while Jeetu believes she left in anger at him.

episodesList.title: Will Jeetu Tell The Family About Latika?
episodesList.summary: Savi returns home and hides directly in her room. Jeetu decides to tell Savi and his family about Latika. Just then, Mamaji calls Savi, and she breaks her vow of silence.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Gives Saavi a Birthday Surprise
episodesList.summary: Jeetu plans a birthday surprise for Saavi with Latika’s help. Later, Jeetu and Saavi try to sneak out at night for a stroll, but Latika and Lattu plot a clever trick to stop them.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Makes Saavi’s Birthday Special
episodesList.summary: Jeetu outsmarts Latika’s every move and makes Saavi’s birthday special. Envious, Latika tries to teach him a lesson, but later, Jeetu makes a heartfelt request to a saddened Latika.

episodesList.title: Geeta is Frightened After Seeing a Ghost
episodesList.summary: Lattu vows revenge on Jeetu for hurting Latika, but Jeetu punishes him for troubling Dadaji. Later, Geeta is terrified by a ghost due to Lattu’s mischief, and Latika asks him to make a promise.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Finds a Way to Get Rid Of Latika's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Mamaji urges Jeetu’s family to visit their ancestral goddess temple. Pappi reveals a trick to free Jeetu from Latika and Lattu’s spirits, and Jeetu cleverly persuades Latika to join him at the temple.

episodesList.title: Latika Comes to The Family Deity’s Temple
episodesList.summary: Jeetu’s family reaches the family deity’s temple. Lattu warns Latika about Triloki Baba, yet she comes to the temple. Later, an incident outside the temple leaves Jeetu stunned.

episodesList.title: Saavi and Latika’s Meeting At The Temple
episodesList.summary: Jeetu panics after seeing Saavi and Latika talk. Both pray for him, leaving Geeta puzzled. Later, Triloki Baba traps Latika inside a mystical circle.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Hands Latika Over to Triloki Baba
episodesList.summary: Latika hides the truth from Jeetu’s family and performs the puja. Jeetu hands her spirit over to Triloki Baba, as Latika pleads for rescue. Even Lattu begs Jeetu to spare her fate.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Applies Vermilion to Latika
episodesList.summary: Jeetu rescues Latika from Triloki Baba and fills her hair parting with vermilion. Saavi is heartbroken to see this, but doesn't confront Jeetu. Later, she questions him about his other wife.

episodesList.title: Jeetu’s Betrayal Drives Saavi to Leave Home
episodesList.summary: Jeetu’s family smears sacred ash on the doorstep, blocking Latika’s entry. Shattered by Jeetu’s betrayal, Saavi leaves home and later vows to fight Latika to win Jeetu back.

episodesList.title: Latika and Saavi Write Love Letters to Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Saavi sets her plan in motion to win Jeetu back. Latika pens a long love letter and urges him to read it, just as Saavi walks in and hands Jeetu her own letter.

episodesList.title: Latika Gives Jeetu a Lunchbox
episodesList.summary: Latika gives Jeetu a lunchbox, raising Saavi’s suspicions. Pappi backs Jeetu in his lies to Saavi, while Lattu teaches Latika how to use a mobile phone.

episodesList.title: Latika’s Actions Land Jeetu In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Latika sends Jeetu a voice message just as Saavi asks for his phone, prompting him to throw it into the water. Later, Rita and Geeta reveal the stolen family bangles, uncovering a hidden truth.

episodesList.title: Saavi Confronts Jeetu Over Latika
episodesList.summary: Jeetu seeks Latika’s help to get rid of his phone, but Saavi’s questions shake him to the core. Soon after, Savi discovers the truth that Ritika is the one who stole the bangles.

episodesList.title: Saavi’s Plan to Catch Latika
episodesList.summary: Saavi reclaims the bangle from Ritika, inviting conflict, and puts up posters in the neighbourhood to track down Latika. Alarmed, Jeetu hides Latika and Lattu, but Saavi grows suspicious of him.

episodesList.title: Saavi Confronts Latika
episodesList.summary: Saavi trails Latika and confronts her about stepping into Jeetu’s life. Jeetu’s revelation that Latika is his first wife leaves Saavi stunned, leading both women to challenge each other.

episodesList.title: Saavi and Latika Challenge Each Other
episodesList.summary: Jeetu’s dream of a simple life shatters when he ends up with two wives - one quirky and one ghostly. With four parents, two bosses and two wives, chaos is his only constant.

episodesList.title: Who Will Bring a Gift for Jeetu First?
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika plan to surprise Jeetu with a Valentine’s Day gift. Soon, they learn that he once wished for a talking parrot in childhood, and Jeetu even gives them money to buy the gift.

episodesList.title: Latika’s Plan to Buy a Parrot for Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Lattu hilariously turns Pappi into a parrot to teach him a lesson. Saavi and Latika hit the ATM and the alert sends Jeetu into a panic. Meanwhile, Latika cooks up her own plan to buy a parrot.

episodesList.title: The Parrot Reveals Jeetu’s Secret to the Family
episodesList.summary: Latika gives a parrot the power to speak and buys it with Saavi. When Saavi brings it home, the family is stunned as the parrot blurts out Jeetu’s secret about having two wives.

episodesList.title: The Parrot That Sparks Chaos at Jeetu's Home
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts in Jeetu’s home when the talking parrot creates trouble, and Latika fails to take back its power to speak. Soon, Saavi and Latika try to impress Jeetu, and the police arrive at his house.

episodesList.title: Ritika’s Plan Fails Because of a Talking Parrot
episodesList.summary: Latika and Lattu’s antics almost land Jeetu in jail, forcing him to confide in Pappi. Meanwhile, a talking parrot exposes Ritika’s robbery plan, and Latika grows fearful of losing Jeetu.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Reveals Latika’s Reality to Saavi
episodesList.summary: On Mahashivratri, Jeetu tells Latika and Saavi his decision. Ritika plots to usurp her parents' property. Later, Latika saves Jeetu from an accident, making him finally reveal her reality to Saavi.

episodesList.title: Saavi Is Shocked After Discovering Latika’s Truth
episodesList.summary: Saavi is shaken after uncovering Latika’s truth and regrets over doubting Jeetu. Later, Jeetu shares his inner conflict, and soon Saavi makes up her mind to drive Latika out of their lives forever.

episodesList.title: The Truth Behind Dadaji’s Will Is Out
episodesList.summary: Latika intimidates Saavi and orders her to leave Jeetu’s life. Later, Bablu’s lawyer arrives to reveal Jeetu’s grandfather’s will, and Ritika threatens Bablu after learning the truth.

episodesList.title: Saavi Is After Latika
episodesList.summary: Saavi brings Triloki Baba’s sacred ash to weaken Latika’s powers and uses chilli smoke to corner her. Meanwhile, Ritika sneaks into Suresh and Reeta’s room to steal the will, but they wake up.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Finds a Way to Keep Both Wives Happy
episodesList.summary: Jeetu compels Savi to return Latika's powers. On Pappi's advice, he later tries a trick to keep both wives happy. Meanwhile, Jeetu's family summon Inspector Bhopal to nab the thief.

episodesList.title: Latika and Saavi Discover Jeetu’s Lie
episodesList.summary: Latika and Saavi pretend to reconcile. Jeetu’s family accuses Katori of theft, and Lattu pulls a prank. Later, Latika and Saavi discover the truth behind Jeetu’s lie.

episodesList.title: Latika Threatens to Kill Saavi
episodesList.summary: Latika threatens to kill Saavi, prompting Saavi to uncover why she cannot do it. Jeetu’s family corners Saavi with a grave question, and Saavi fires back with a warning for Latika.

episodesList.title: The Family Grows Suspicious of Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika team up to teach Jeetu a lesson by openly pampering him. But when the family spots Pappi in a saree beside Jeetu, they jump to the conclusion that he has secretly remarried.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Introduces Pappi as His Second Wife
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika smear colour on Jeetu and shower him playfully, while Ritika schemes to separate Jeetu and Saavi. Later, Jeetu stuns everyone by introducing Pappi to the family as his second wife.

episodesList.title: Latika Smears Colour on Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Pappi’s disguise is exposed, leading to him and Jeetu being thrashed. Before Holika Dahan, Latika drenches the wood Saavi brought and then smears colour on Jeetu before Saavi can reach him.

episodesList.title: Ritika Catches Jeetu With Saavi and Latika
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika plan to trouble Jeetu on Holi. Latika cooks for the family, but Saavi takes the credit. Later, Ritika sees Jeetu applying colour to Saavi and Latika.

episodesList.title: The Family Celebrates Holi
episodesList.summary: Ritika comes to tell the family about Jeetu’s two wives, but Latika confuses her. The family celebrates Holi, and Latika feels sad when she sees Saavi receiving all the love from the family.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Jeetu decides to reveal the truth to his family, but Saavi and Latika stop him. The police arrive to arrest him for having two wives, and Ritika claims his second wife is Mrs Pandey.

episodesList.title: Saavi and Latika Fall Into Jeetu’s Trap
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika blackmail the inspector to free Jeetu and the family. While the family confronts Jeetu about his two marriages, he sets his own trap to uncover Saavi and Latika’s plan.

episodesList.title: A Demonic Force Enters Triloki Baba’s World
episodesList.summary: A demonic force frees several spirits from Triloki Baba’s hold and meets Latika in his form. Soon after, Triloki Baba sends her a warning to stay cautious and not abandon Jeetu’s side.

episodesList.title: Jeetu’s Family Awaits the Joyful Arrival of a Baby
episodesList.summary: Jeetu’s parents express their wish for Saavi to bring a little one into the family, but Latika keeps the couple apart. Soon, a misunderstanding leads everyone to believe that Saavi is pregnant.

episodesList.title: A Demonic Force Tries to Harm Latika
episodesList.summary: Saavi tells Jeetu that she is pregnant, while Ritika plans to harm Saavi. Later, a demonic force comes to harm Latika, but Triloki Baba stops it.

episodesList.title: Latika’s Decision to Leave Jeetu
episodesList.summary: Latika learns that Saavi is pregnant and grows furious with Jeetu. Ritika secretly adds something to Saavi’s curd, and Latika’s misunderstanding deepens, leading her to decide to leave Jeetu.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Tries to Stop Latika From Leaving
episodesList.summary: Jeetu fails to expose Saavi’s lie. Meanwhile, unaware that a demon waits inside the tree, Latika prepares to enter it. Later, Jeetu urges Saavi to stop her.

episodesList.title: Saavi’s Lie Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Jeetu stops Latika from merging into the tree, while Saavi’s lie is exposed to the family. Latika decides to reveal the truth, but the demon pushes Lattu into a fire pit and meets her in his form.

episodesList.title: A Demon Arrives in the Form of Jeetu’s Friend
episodesList.summary: Latika reveals about her relationship with Jeetu to the family, but he cleverly keeps it from coming out. Later, a demon in the form of Jeetu's friend Maddy saves Saavi and Latika from a cooker blast.

episodesList.title: Maddy’s Behaviour Troubles Saavi and Latika
episodesList.summary: Maddy showers everyone with gifts and insists on staying in Jeetu and Saavi’s room. His behaviour unsettles Saavi and Latika, while the demon lurking inside him grows restless for its revenge.

episodesList.title: Saavi Receives a Major Responsibility
episodesList.summary: Latika tries to sabotage Saavi's efforts as she takes charge of the household. Maddy tells Ritika he knows about her plot. Later, Saavi is entrusted with the donation money for the new temple.

episodesList.title: Jeetu and Maddy's Arm‑Wrestling Match
episodesList.summary: Jeetu and Maddy engage in an arm‑wrestling match. Maddy shifts into his evil form and tries taking Jeetu away, but fails. Ritika comes to steal the donation money from the safe, but finds it missing.

episodesList.title: Donation Money Missing From the Locker
episodesList.summary: Maddy blackmails Ritika with a video. Saavi tells everyone she’s lost the locker key, and though Rita and Geeta give her a fake one, all are stunned to find the donation money missing.

episodesList.title: Maddy Makes a Dangerous Move
episodesList.summary: When the neighbourhood erupts over missing donation money, Maddy suddenly returns with a man and hands it back. Jeetu’s family praises him, unaware of his hidden move.

episodesList.title: Maddy Is Shaken by Jeetu’s Words
episodesList.summary: Jeetu tells Saavi and Latika to apologise to Maddy, while Maddy stops Rita and Geeta from applying tilak to him. Later, a drunk Jeetu tells Maddy he feels he is not the real Maddy, leaving him shaken.

episodesList.title: Maddy’s Words Shock Jeetu, Saavi and Latika
episodesList.summary: Maddy escapes Jeetu’s questions by playing a trick. Geeta and Rita panic when they see a black magic effigy in the house. Later, Maddy's words shock Jeetu, Saavi and Latika.

episodesList.title: Maddy Narrates a Story to Jeetu, Saavi and Latika
episodesList.summary: Maddy narrates a story to Jeetu, Saavi and Latika, where Triloki Baba sacrifices his blood to fight evil. Later, Maddy takes Jeetu to the terrace and threatens to kill him.

episodesList.title: Maddy Hypnotises Latika
episodesList.summary: Maddy hypnotises Ramesh and Suresh, making them attack Rita and Geeta. Triloki Baba sacrifices his blood to free Lattu from the demon's clutches, before Maddy casts his spell on Latika too.

episodesList.title: Latika and Saavi Discover Maddy’s True Identity
episodesList.summary: By distracting Jeetu, Latika and Savi reach a cave, where they see Maddy in the form of a Yaksha. Latika then reveals the entire truth to Saavi. Soon, Triloki Baba senses Latika’s presence around him.

episodesList.title: Triloki Baba Reveals a Shocking Truth to Latika
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika unite to save Jeetu from Yaksh. Trapped in a cave, Triloki Baba tells Latika the way to kill Yaksh, just as Yaksh drags Lattu back inside.

episodesList.title: Saavi and Latika Discover a Shocking Truth
episodesList.summary: Latika and Saavi reveal the truth about Maddy to Jeetu, but he refuses to believe them. Kept indoors for his safety, the duo soon stumble upon a shocking new truth.

episodesList.title: Maddy Takes Jeetu Out of the House
episodesList.summary: Maddy sneaks Jeetu out, hiding him from Rita and Geeta. As Triloki Baba summons a divine trident to end Yaksh, a shaken Saavi reveals she knows where Jeetu is.

episodesList.title: Yaksh Holds Jeetu Captive
episodesList.summary: Yaksh, in Maddy’s form, captures Jeetu and later attacks him as Yaksh. Triloki Baba does a yajna, and Saavi and Latika fight with Yaksh. Meanwhile, a hypnotised Pappi strangles Ramesh and Suresh.

episodesList.title: The Fall of Yaksh
episodesList.summary: Jeetu, Saavi and Latika end Yaksh's life using Triloki Baba’s blessed trident and later return home to reveal the truth of their past lives. Suddenly, Saavi hears the cry of an ominous cat.

episodesList.title: Jeetu’s New Boss Arrives at His Office
episodesList.summary: Saavi’s remarks hurt Latika, but Jeetu consoles her. Later, the news of Jeetu’s new boss sparks jealousy in Saavi and Latika. At the office, Bachchan aims a gun and threatens Jeetu.

episodesList.title: Latika Suspects Jeetu’s Boss Sheena
episodesList.summary: Jeetu’s new boss Sheena teaches Bachchan a lesson as Saavi and Latika visit Jeetu’s office to meet her. Elsewhere, Ritika claims Saavi is possessed, while Latika grows suspicious of Sheena.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Brings Sheena Home
episodesList.summary: Sheena arrives in Jeetu’s neighbourhood and he brings her home. Later, Sheena saves Ramesh from a snake bite, while Triloki Baba receives shocking news.

episodesList.title: Yaksh Is Alive
episodesList.summary: Triloki Baba learns Yaksh is alive, while Jeetu’s family asks Sheena to stay with them. Saavi refuses and warns Jeetu to keep his distance, and later, Jeetu spots something shocking.

episodesList.title: Yaksh Makes His Move
episodesList.summary: Disguised as Lattu, Yaksh deceives Triloki Baba about Latika’s life. Later, posing as Mamaji, he sends Geeta and Rita to bring Sheena home. However, Sheena strikes back.

episodesList.title: Jeetu Returns Home With Sheena
episodesList.summary: Sheena’s lie lures Jeetu into bringing her home. Yaksh hypnotises Triloki Baba, turning him into a slave, while a reluctant Saavi is forced to let Sheena stay.

episodesList.title: Sheena and Yaksh's True Intentions
episodesList.summary: Sheena, also known as Mohini, meets with Yaksh and their true motives are revealed. Saavi attacks Geeta, shocking the family, while Latika blames Sheena.

episodesList.title: Latika Warns Sheena
episodesList.summary: Latika and Saavi argue with Jeetu over Sheena. Ritika urges Geeta and Rita to send Saavi to her maternal home. Later, Latika confronts Sheena with a firm warning.

episodesList.title: Saavi Sees Sheena and Jeetu Together
episodesList.summary: Saavi and Latika meet Triloki Baba. Saavi is shocked to see Sheena in Jeetu’s arms and lashes out, but joy follows as Sheena reveals Jeetu’s dream project is finally taking shape.

episodesList.title: Sheena and Ritika Come Together
episodesList.summary: Triloki Baba’s guru frees him from Yaksh’s grip, forming a protective shield. Saavi and Jeetu reconcile, while Ritika uncovers Sheena’s true intent and the two unite.

episodesList.title: Sheena Hatches a Ploy to Defame Jeetu
episodesList.summary: At the office, Sheena tries to hypnotise Jeetu and plots with Bachchan Thakur to malign him. Latika steps in, saves Jeetu, and makes a shocking revelation.

episodesList.title: Latika and Saavi Force Bachchan to Reveal the Truth
episodesList.summary: Latika cautions Jeetu about Sheena, but he brushes it off. Later, Latika and Saavi force Bachchan to spill the truth behind the conspiracy against Jeetu, while Triloki Baba reaches his home.

episodesList.title: Triloki Baba Helpless Under Yaksh’s Spell
episodesList.summary: Triloki Baba says it is safe to keep Sheena at home, unaware that he is under Yaksh’s spell. Jeetu scolds Latika and Saavi, while Yaksh and Sheena celebrate their plan’s success with a hug.

episodesList.title: Sheena Is Forced to Leave Pandey Nivas
episodesList.summary: Jeetu decides to move Sheena to another home. Sheena dares Latika and Saavi to win Jeetu, but when the truth emerges, she launches a deadly attack on the Pandey family.

episodesList.title: Pressure Mounts on Saavi to Bring Sheena Back
episodesList.summary: Mamaji claims that Ramesh–Suresh and Rita–Geeta’s downfall began after Sheena left the house. Saavi is pressured to bring Sheena back, unaware that it is all part of Sheena’s plot.

plotHtml: Jeetu is raised by two sets of parents. He has everything doubled in his life, including two mothers, two fathers, and two bosses. Now, destiny gives him two wives. Jeetu wants a simple, devoted wife, but just before his marriage, an astrologer tells him for a symbolic marriage with a tree that turned into a spirit named Latika, who believes that she is Jeetu’s real wife. Now, Jeetu is caught between his actual wife, Savi, and Latika. What will he do now?

title: Ganesh Kartikey
summary: Gatha Shiv Parivaar Ki — Ganesh Kartikey also known as Ganesh Kartikey is an Indian Hindi-language television mythology series that aired on Sony SAB from 6 October 2025 to 4 April 2026 and is digitally available on SonyLIV. Produced by Peninsula Pictures, it starred Shrenu Parikh, Avinesh Rekhi, Mohit Malik, Subhan Khan and Nirnay Samadhiya.
plot: The divine family of Shiva and Parvati, brothers Ganesha and Kartikeya struggle with rivalry, resentment, and longing. One is the thinker, the other becomes warrior bound by destiny. As Kartikeya battles abandonment and Ganesha seeks acceptance, their bond becomes a mirror of every family's contradictions.

title: Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan
summary: Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiere from 22 September 2025 on Zee TV. It is produced by Ravi Dubey and Sargun Mehta, the series is a remake of the Telugu TV series Radhamma Kuthuru of Zee Telugu. It stars Amandeep Sidhu, Shubhangi Latkar, Srishti Jain, Namrata Pradhan and Sheezan Khan in lead roles.
plot:
Set in the spiritual city of Varanasi, Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan follows the inspiring journey of Ganga Mai, a resilient woman who is abandoned by her husband for not bearing a son. Determined to defy social stigma, she raises her three daughters Sahana, Sneha, and Soni with pride, strength, and unwavering love. Ganga earns a living by running a small dhaba and becomes a symbol of courage in her community.
As the daughters grow, each faces her own struggles: Sneha is bold and justice-driven, Sahana shoulders family responsibilities, and young Soni begins to understand the challenges around her. Sneha’s life takes a turn when she crosses paths with Siddhu, a rough but good-hearted man caught between his feelings for her and his powerful mother Durgavati’s ambitions.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Shubhangi Latkar as Ganga Sharma: Manohar's first wife.(2025—present) * Srishti Jain / Namrata Pradhan as Sahana Sharma: Ganga and Monohar's eldest daughter.(2025—2026)(2026—present) * Amandeep Sidhu as Sneha Sharma: Ganga and Manohar's younger daughter;(2025—present) * Vaishnavi Prajapati as Soni Sharma: Ganga and Manohar's youngest daughter, (2025—present) * Sheezan Khan as Siddhanth Singh Thakur aka Siddhu: Durgavati's son.(2025—present) * Rohin Joshi as Murli: Kaushalya's son; professor at Soni's college (2025—present) * Indira Krishnan as Durgavati Thakur: Madhu and Siddhu's mother(2025—present)

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Sheezan Khan was signed to play male lead, Siddhu. Shubhangi Latkar was confirmed to play Ganga Mai. Indira Krishnan had been cast as the main villain, Durgavati. Srishti Jain was cast as the eldest sister, Sahana. In May, Srishti Jain quit the show and replaced by Marathi actress Namrata Pradhan as Sahaana.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The series was released on 22 September 2025 replacing Kumkum Bhagya at the 9 PM slot. By doing so, the show became the first non-Balaji Telefilms show in 19 years to air at that slot.
