episodesList.title: Ganga Mai's fierce daughters
episodesList.summary: Abandoned by her husband for birthing three daughters, Ganga runs a humble 'dhaba', facing trouble from her jealous co-wife, Indu. But her daughters stand strong as her fiercest shield.

episodesList.title: Siddhu falls for Sneha at first sight
episodesList.summary: Siddhu, son of Banaras’s fierce Thakurain Durgavati, worships his mother but loses his heart to Sneha at first sight. Upset with her humiliation, Indu plots to usurp Ganga’s home and dhaba.

episodesList.title: Siddhu arrives at Ganga Mai Ki Rasoi
episodesList.summary: Siddhu thrashes an MLA for badmouthing Durgavati. Later, Ganga's husband Manohar asks Durgavati to have Ganga's dhaba vacated. Siddhu goes to enforce his demand and is stunned to face Sneha.

episodesList.title: Durgavati arranged Siddhu's alliance
episodesList.summary: Ganga tells Shanta why she endured Manohar’s abuse. Meanwhile, Durgavati arranges Siddhu’s match with Purvi, unaware that Siddhu has already chosen Sneha as his life partner.

episodesList.title: Sneha puts Ganga in a tough spot
episodesList.summary: Shanta confides in Sneha about her troubles. Ganga decides to talk to Manohar for the daughters’ kanyadaan, but hesitates after learning that Sneha plans to take a firm stand against him.

episodesList.title: Sneha looks for a distressed Ganga
episodesList.summary: Sahana tells Sneha that Ganga has gone missing. Sneha grabs Siddhu’s bike and rushes to find her, but panics at the sight of a body near the bridge. Meanwhile, Siddhu lies to Durgavati.

episodesList.title: Will Shekar accept Durgavati's condition
episodesList.summary: Sneha arrives at the police station to return Sidhu’s bike and her message on it, sparks his romantic imagination. Meanwhile, Durgavati sets a condition to forgive Shekhar.

episodesList.title: Siddhu is furious as Sneha bad mouths Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Shekhar's mother and Durgavati come face-to-face at a saree shop, and she tells Sneha about Durgavati. When Siddhu overhears Sneha badmouthing Durgavati at the 'dhaba', he gets furious.

episodesList.title: Soni tops her class
episodesList.summary: Sahana serves Soni's new college professor, Murli, her own share of food at the dhaba. Later, Soni tops the college, leaving Indu frustrated with envy.

episodesList.title: Sneha saves Ganga from Manohar
episodesList.summary: Manohar threatens Ganga to vacate the house, but Sneha comes to her rescue, warns Manohar and ousts him from the house. Later, due to a misunderstanding, Sneha scolds Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Durgavati's decision shocks Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Siddhu is shaken when Durgavati chooses Purvi over Sneha as his match. Later, a drunk Manohar causes a scene at her home, prompting Durgavati to make him a promise.

episodesList.title: Ganga is concerned about Sahana
episodesList.summary: Sneha lifts Ganga’s spirits as she worries about Sahana’s future. After Siddhu’s friends beat up Manohar, he turns to Sneha for help. Later, Shekhar takes Sneha along to the temple to meet Madhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Durgavati's clash
episodesList.summary: Sneha sings the aarti after temple rituals. Murli visits the dhaba, pretending to eat, to meet Sahana. Outside a temple, Durgavati sees Shekhar with Madhu and fumes, sparking a clash with Sneha.

episodesList.title: A hurdle in Sahana's marriage proposal
episodesList.summary: A hurdle arises in Sahana’s marriage proposal, and Sneha shares her wish with Bhagwandas. Kali shares his plan with Indu to evict Ganga from the dhaba. Just then, Purvi arrives at the dhaba.

episodesList.title: Sneha sees Siddhu at Purvi's house
episodesList.summary: Durgavati arrives at Purvi's house with Madhu and Siddhu. When Sneha comes to deliver food, she spots Siddhu and suspects he’s Durgavati’s son. Later, Manohar and Indu meet Ganga with a proposal.

episodesList.title: Indu and Manohar's offer to Ganga
episodesList.summary: At Purvi's house, Siddhu meets Sneha and recognises the food, realising that Purvi had ordered it from Ganga's dhaba. Meanwhile, Indu and Manohar offer Ganga INR 10 lakh along with a proposal.

episodesList.title: Ganga keeps her worries hidden
episodesList.summary: Madhu senses Siddhu’s love for Sneha and lies to her. Meanwhile, Ganga hides INR 10 lakh given by Manohar from her daughters, but Sahana questions her after noticing her anxiety.

episodesList.title: Sahana learns about the money
episodesList.summary: Sahana learns about Ganga’s issues. Shekhar uses Sneha’s phone to wish Madhu a happy birthday, while Durgavati checks Madhu’s phone. At the café, Siddhu arrives for a collection and spots Sneha.

episodesList.title: Ganga falls prey to theft
episodesList.summary: Ganga arrives with Sahana to return INR 10 lakh to Manohar, but he refuses and threatens her. Later, she’s robbed. Meanwhile, Sneha and Siddhu cross paths and get to know each other.

episodesList.title: Ganga keeps Sneha in the dark
episodesList.summary: Ganga and Sahana reach the police station to report a robbery, but the inspector insults them. Murli arrives at the eatery with a gift for Sahana. Ganga soon returns and conceals the truth from Sneha.

episodesList.title: Siddhu uses an excuse to see Sneha
episodesList.summary: Seeing the pairs of footwear, Sahana realises that Murali left a gift for her at the dhaba. That night, Siddhu disguises his friends as beggars to sneak them into the dhaba and meet Sneha.

episodesList.title: A marriage proposal for Sahana
episodesList.summary: Bhagwandas brings a marriage proposal for Sahana, worrying Murali. Ganga feels reluctant about the proposal due to the money theft, but Sneha gets Sahana’s consent. Later, Siddhu makes a resolve.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Purvi run into each other
episodesList.summary: Murli fails to profess his feelings to Sahana, while Indu sends Kali and her men to threaten Ganga at the dhaba. Later, Sneha and Purvi unexpectedly cross paths in a bazaar.

episodesList.title: Sneha argues with Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Sneha and Purvi’s clash turns violent, but Durgawati intervenes and argues with Sneha. Siddhu shares his worries with Madhu. The next day, Ganga prepares to welcome Sahana's prospective groom.

episodesList.title: Indu insults Ganga in public
episodesList.summary: Siddhu rushes to the eatery after misreading the suitor Sandeep’s visit. Enraged by Sneha’s court notice, Indu storms into Ganga’s house and insults her in front of Sandeep’s family.

episodesList.title: Sneha is blamed for Sahana's broken alliance
episodesList.summary: A heartbroken Ganga blames Sneha for Sahana’s failed alliance, while Murli is hopeful of marrying her. Meanwhile, Siddhu asks Chanchal to find out the dhaba details to ease Sneha’s worries.

episodesList.title: Sneha ana Siddhu cross paths at court
episodesList.summary: Sahana quietly longs for Murli. At court, Sneha discusses her case with Shekhar. Siddhu brings Madhu to help them meet, but Durgavati arrives unexpectedly. Meanwhile, Purvi is urged to charm Siddhu.

episodesList.title: An old foe plots against Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Soni fumes over not having new clothes for college and taunts Sahana. Siddhu confides in Madhu about his apprehensions. Ganga is invited to a Panchayat event and an old foe plots against Durgawati.

episodesList.title: A hitman arrives at the diwali mela
episodesList.summary: Ganga attends the Ramleela with her daughters and delights the organisers. Sneha agrees to play Sita, prompting Siddhu to seek Ram’s role. Meanwhile, a hitman arrives there to target Durgawati.

episodesList.title: Indu publicly insults Ganga
episodesList.summary: Siddhu confesses his feelings to Sneha under the guise of rehearsals. Purvi complains to Durgawati about his disinterest. At the event, Indu grows furious when Ganga is honoured and insults her.

episodesList.title: Siddhu and Sneha's Ramleela
episodesList.summary: Siddhu and Sneha take the stage for Ramleela and exchange garlands. Durgawati arrives, and Siddhu is flustered when he sees her among the audience. Siddhu tries to keep Sneha from revealing her face.

episodesList.title: Will Sneha learn Siddhu's truth?
episodesList.summary: Siddhu puts on an act and ends the play abruptly. When Durgawati honours the actors, a sniper targets her. Siddhu saves her, and amidst the chaos, Sneha discovers that Siddhu is Durgawati’s son.

episodesList.title: Sahana walks on fire
episodesList.summary: Sahana endures a painful penance, hoping it will help her family trace the stolen money. Meanwhile, Indu vows to ruin Ganga's reputation, and Durgawati confronts Siddhu about his lies.

episodesList.title: Purvi lies to Durgavati
episodesList.summary: As Madhu pushes Siddhu to give a thoughtful gift to Sneha, Purvi wins Durgawati’s favour with deceit. Meanwhile, Kali sets her sights on an unsuspecting Sahana on finding her alone at the eatery.

episodesList.title: Inspection at Ganga's eatery
episodesList.summary: Murli stops Kali from troubling Sahana at the eatery. Siddhu brings Ganga back and earns her blessings. Later, food inspectors arrive at Indu’s behest, but Ganga receives unexpected help.

episodesList.title: Ganga asks Indu for a favour
episodesList.summary: Sneha argues with Siddhu over his parked car but soon regrets it. Ganga tells Indu that her loan money has been stolen and seeks time to repay it. Siddhu and his men probe the eatery’s ownership.

episodesList.title: Vimla plans Shekar's remarriage
episodesList.summary: Ganga considers taking a loan from Durgawati to repay Indu's loan. Vimla crosses paths with Durgawati and announces her plan to get Shekhar remarried. Later, Madhu learns about Vimla’s intentions.

episodesList.title: Madhu tries to end her life
episodesList.summary: Madhu tells Shekhar about Vimla’s plan and, in despair, tries to end her life. Meanwhile, Ganga pleads with Durgawati for financial help. Durgawati refuses to help Ganga and breaks her heart.

episodesList.title: Durgavati agrees to loan Ganga the money
episodesList.summary: In a shocking turn of events, Durgawati agrees to give a loan of INR 10 lakhs to Ganga. Later, Sneha arrives with Siddhu at Durgawati’s house to save Madhu, and Ganga spots her there.

episodesList.title: Siddhu learns about Ganga's visit
episodesList.summary: Sneha helps Shekhar speak to Madhu, and they're relieved to learn she didn’t attempt suicide. Later, Siddhu learns why Ganga visited Durgawati, then bumps into Sneha and offers to drop her home.

episodesList.title: Sneha confronts Munna
episodesList.summary: During Lakshmi Puja, Siddhu vows to uncover the truth about Ganga’s loan request. Madhu recalls how Sneha saved her life. The next day, Sneha confronts Munna as he collects money in Siddhu’s name.

episodesList.title: Amarnath tries to deliver the loan money
episodesList.summary: Sneha meets Siddhu at the market, where he poses an uncomfortable question. On learning that Amarnath never gave Ganga the money, Durgawati sends him to deliver it and Sneha spots him in the eatery.

episodesList.title: Purvi pretends to end her life
episodesList.summary: Madhu asks Siddhu to meet Ganga and offer financial help. Purvi visits Durgawati’s mansion and laments Siddhu’s indifference. As Durgawati consoles her, Purvi pretends to end her life to win her over.

episodesList.title: Siddhu considers giving up on Sneha
episodesList.summary: Durgawati vows to get Purvi married to Siddhu, leaving him shattered. Sneha gives her savings to Soni for her fees. Siddhu drowns his grief in alcohol and considers letting go of his love for Sneha.

episodesList.title: Murli offers his savings to Sahana
episodesList.summary: Madhu helps a drunk Siddhu hide from Durgawati and tries to comfort him. Murli offers his savings to Sahana, but she refuses. Later, Siddhu silences Ganga with an uncomfortable question.

episodesList.title: Manohar Vows to seize Ganga's eatery
episodesList.summary: Ganga refuses to accept Siddhu's help. Sneha discovers Siddhu’s gift and confronts him. At the shrine, a sari sparks a tender moment between them. Meanwhile, Manohar vows to seize Ganga’s property.

episodesList.title: Siddhu disguises as an ascetic
episodesList.summary: At Poojari’s behest, Siddhu disguises himself as an ascetic to express his love to Sneha. Manohar manipulates Sahana to get Ganga’s thumbprint on property papers. Sneha grows suspicious of Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha files a complaint with the police
episodesList.summary: Soni asks Ganga a question about Manohar, upsetting Sneha. Manohar gloats about deceiving Sahana and Indu threatens to kill him if his plan fails. Later, Sneha files a complaint against Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Siddhu lies to Sneha about his job
episodesList.summary: The officer refuses Sneha’s complaint until she asserts her rights. Siddhu learns of this and lies about his profession when he meets Sneha. Meanwhile, Manohar goes hungry for breaking his promise.

episodesList.title: Sneha finds the property papers
episodesList.summary: Sneha remains unaware that Siddhu is Durgawati’s son. Poojari forces the constable to lie to Durgawati about the complainant. Sneha finds the property papers Sahana hid and confronts Ganga.

episodesList.title: Sneha confronts Manohar
episodesList.summary: Sneha confronts Manohar for manipulating Sahana. Indu creates an uproar, leaving Sahana anxious that Ganga's secret may be exposed. When Sneha threatens legal action, Ganga intervenes to stop her.

episodesList.title: Sneha relents to Ganga's threat
episodesList.summary: Sneha plans to sue Manohar, but Ganga threatens self-harm and forces her to relent. Later, Purvi asks Siddhu to join her for a movie as Durgawati sets out for her temple trip.

episodesList.title: Sneha teaches Indu a lesson
episodesList.summary: Urged by Durgawati, Siddhu takes Purvi to a movie. Manohar arrives there with Indu. Soon, Sneha and her family confront Indu over the seats. Siddhu grows anxious, terrified Sneha might see him.

episodesList.title: Gunfight at the theatre!
episodesList.summary: Siddhu thinks of Sneha as Purvi leans on him during the film. When some men harass Sahana and Sneha, he steps in and they draw a gun. Purvi alerts Durgawati, who arrives swiftly and ends the clash.

episodesList.title: Siddhu visits Purvi
episodesList.summary: Indu plans to seek Durgawati’s help to oust Ganga’s family. Durgawati hunts the complainant as Sneha thanks Siddhu, leaving him anxious. He meets Purvi, while Sneha is warned about a stalker.

episodesList.title: Vimla confronts Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Siddhu sets out to meet Sneha, but she senses she is being followed and slips away. Meanwhile, Vimla confronts Durgawati over Shekhar’s calls to Madhu. Sahana visits Soni’s college in search of Murli.

episodesList.title: Indu confronts Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Sneha fails to discover that Siddhu had asked his allies to keep a watch on her. Indu sets out to confront Durgawati despite Manohar’s protests. Later, Paras warns Sahana about Indu’s intentions.

episodesList.title: Indu convinces Durgavati to help her
episodesList.summary: Indu pleads with Durgawati to help acquire her seized land. Despite Indu’s lies, Durgawati arrives at the dhaba with her recruits and comes face-to-face with Ganga.

episodesList.title: Durgavati mediates Ganga and Indu's dispute
episodesList.summary: Indu learns that Ganga had tried to borrow money from Durgawati. Later, Ganga reveals about the money theft, and Durgawati considers holding a panchayat to resolve the dispute.

episodesList.title: Durgavati to hold panchayat
episodesList.summary: Durgawati declares that the panchayat will resolve Indu and Ganga’s dispute. With a warning to Indu, Durgawati departs. Meanwhile, Sneha misunderstands Siddhu’s love confession.

episodesList.title: Ganga is troubled
episodesList.summary: Indu leaves for home, while Durgawati waits outside Ganga’s dhaba for Siddhu after her car breaks down. Ganga imagines a fierce clash between Durgawati and Sneha, and soon, Sneha arrives there.

episodesList.title: Paras alerts Sneha of India's motives
episodesList.summary: Ganga lies to Sneha about Indu’s visit. Indu celebrates Durgawati’s verdict, and Paras warns Sneha of her intentions. Siddhu struggles to prevent Ganga’s family from being dragged to the Panchayat.

episodesList.title: Indu catches Manohar meeting Ganga
episodesList.summary: Ganga secretly meets Manohar to stop the panchayat hearing, but Indu catches them and vows to use it against her. Siddhu seeks to protect Ganga as Sneha’s suspicions lead her to Manohar’s house.

episodesList.title: Ganga spots the thief
episodesList.summary: Soni tries to alert Sneha about the stolen money, but Sahana stops her. Ganga spots the thief’s bike and chases it, causing an accident. Siddhu offers to help her and learns about the bike.

episodesList.title: Villagers assemble for panchayat
episodesList.summary: Ganga sends Sneha away to keep her from learning about the panchayat. Siddhu pursues the thief and Indu readies her case. As the hearing begins, Ganga reaches and Soni leaves with Paras to find Sneha.

episodesList.title: Indu corners Ganga
episodesList.summary: Indu accuses Ganga of fraud at the Panchayat and uses a video to corner her. Durgawati silences Ganga with a question. Indu demands an apology from Ganga, while Sneha rushes to the hearing.

episodesList.title: Durgavati rules in Indu's favour
episodesList.summary: Durgawati rules in Indu’s favour and asks Ganga to apologise. Ganga complies, but the hearing takes a shocking turn and Durgawati reverses her verdict, leaving the villagers stunned.

episodesList.title: Ganga's actions disappoint Sneha
episodesList.summary: Indu falls at Ganga’s feet, apologising for framing her. Disappointed at her family's deceit, Sneha seeks an explnanation from Ganga and Sahana, while a humiliated Indu vows to retaliate.

episodesList.title: Kali learns of his past
episodesList.summary: Sneha is shattered by Ganga’s deceit and resolves to leave despite her pleas. Indu collapses after revealing Kali’s past, and he contemplates confronting Siddhu for disgracing her.

episodesList.title: Sneha leaves home for good
episodesList.summary: Sneha leaves the house despite Ganga’s desperate appeals. Meanwhile, Kali reels from the truth of his past and vows to find his abductor, while Siddhu learns that Sneha has gone missing.

episodesList.title: Sneha shares her pain with Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Siddhu finds Sneha on a farm machan, and she confides her pain over her family's deceit. He helps her see that Ganga acted under pressure. She returns home with Shekhar, and Ganga makes a promise.

episodesList.title: Kali tries to track his abductor
episodesList.summary: Sneha refuses to forgive Ganga and demands police action. Shekhar visits Madhu, and Durgawati spots his car leaving. Kali and Paras search for the abductor, and Sneha learns of their pursuit.

episodesList.title: Sneha encounters a mysterious fortune teller
episodesList.summary: Sneha follows Paras to track Kali’s abductor, wondering if he is her well-wisher and encounters a mysterious gypsy. Meanwhile, Ganga challenges Durgawati’s past verdict, and Madhu invites Shekhar out.

episodesList.title: A twist of fate awaits Shekar
episodesList.summary: Sneha is speechless as an astrologer predicts her future with Siddhu. Shekhar’s family forces him to see a suitress, but Ganga’s words compel Durgawati to Shekhar’s house, where fate is about to turn.

episodesList.title: Durgavati's choice angers Sneha
episodesList.summary: Soni convinces Sahana she’s in love. Despite Vimla’s insults, Durgawati pleads for Shekhar and Madhu’s reunion. After a clash, Durgawati makes a stern choice, until Sneha arrives, sparking turmoil.

episodesList.title: Sneha's big day!
episodesList.summary: Murli and the college authorities announce Sneha’s IAS triumph. She rescues Shekhar and clears the air with Madhu. Yet, when Ganga wishes to congratulate her, old conflicts keep them apart in silence.

episodesList.title: Kali sets up a liquor shop
episodesList.summary: Sneha chooses Ganga’s sari for her felicitation and, stung by their rift, learns to drape it alone. Meanwhile, Kali sets up a liquor shop outside Ganga’s eatery and Indu confronts Ganga bitterly.

episodesList.title: Kali tries to sabotage the felicitation
episodesList.summary: Indu’s threats unsettle Ganga, yet she attends Sneha’s felicitation at Sahana’s behest. Sneha is puzzled by the grand setup, while Siddhu plans a surprise, and Indu sends Kali to sabotage the event.

episodesList.title: Kali sets the stage on fire
episodesList.summary: Sneha honours Ganga and acknowledges her sacrifices, crediting Ganga for her success. Siddhu’s surprise adds to the festive cheer. Kali, driven by spite, sets the felicitation shamiana ablaze.

episodesList.title: Durgavati storms into Ganga's house in anger
episodesList.summary: Siddhu saves Sneha from the burning shamiana as Indu revels in Ganga’s distress. By morning, news of Sneha’s UPSC success spreads, angering Durgawati, who storms into Ganga’s house.

episodesList.title: Sneha learns about her secret admirer
episodesList.summary: Durgawati gives gifts to Ganga and insists on meeting Sneha. Manju, a new hand at Ganga’s eatery, alerts Indu about this. Sneha learns of her secret admirer, Sahib, from a banner put up in her honour.

episodesList.title: Siddhu learns the truth about Sahib
episodesList.summary: Soni suspects Sahana has feelings for Murli. Sneha’s quest to find Sahib leads Siddhu to the truth. Durgawati confronts Indu for defacing her posters. At Ganga’s eatery, two drunk men harass a girl.

episodesList.title: A drunk man notices siddhu's tattoo
episodesList.summary: Angered by the drunken chaos near Ganga’s eatery, Sneha confronts Kali and vows to shut his liquor shop despite Indu proving its legality. A drunk man notices Siddhu's tattoo and sets out to tip Kali.

episodesList.title: Kali brews a dangerous liquor variant
episodesList.summary: Siddhu poses as a farmer and impresses Sneha at the fields, sharing a rare moment of ease with her. Elsewhere, Kali brews a dangerous liquor variant, while Ganga worries about Durgawati’s invitation.

episodesList.title: Indu alerts Durgavati of Siddhu's actions
episodesList.summary: As fumes from Kali’s alcohol suffocate Sneha, Siddhu rushes her away in his arms. Kali alerts Indu about the sighting and she informs Durgawati. The man who identified Siddhu collapses mysteriously.

episodesList.title: Sneha learns of Durgavati's invitation
episodesList.summary: Durgawati sees Siddhu with Purvi at the field and dismisses Indu’s claims. Shanta rushes to the hospital after learning of her husband’s condition where Ganga informs Sneha about Durgawati’s invite.

episodesList.title: The plot against Sneha, Siddhu and Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Ganga struggles to bring Sneha to Durgawati’s lunch, while Purvi awaits a clash. Indu and Kali conspire with a politician and police to misuse Sneha’s FIR against Durgawati and Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha's complaint sparks rage
episodesList.summary: Ganga’s apology at Durgawati’s house stuns all as Sneha’s dislike towards her surfaces. Meanwhile, Siddhu’s fury erupts when the inspector vows to torment Durgawati after Sneha’s complaint.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's trick fails and Durgavati's anger rises
episodesList.summary: Siddhu fails to stop Sneha from taking the police to his house. Durgawati grows furious on hearing the news, but Indu’s attempt to disrupt her lunch with Ganga’s family enrages her even more.

episodesList.title: Siddhu starts a reckless chase
episodesList.summary: Indu provokes Durgawati, leaving Ganga apologetic. Purvi overhears this and plots an alliance with Indu. When the inspector arrives to arrest Siddhu, he challenges him and sparks a reckless chase.

episodesList.title: Murli tells his mother about Sahana
episodesList.summary: Siddhu confronts and beats the inspector. At Ganga’s house, Indu tries to turn Sneha against Ganga. Murli confides in his mother about Sahana. Later, a sudden marriage proposal surfaces for Sahana.

episodesList.title: Siddhu stages an arrest
episodesList.summary: Durgawati scolds Siddhu for confronting the inspector. Siddhu stages a fake arrest to stop Sneha's pursuit. As Sahana accepts a marriage proposal, Purvi catches Siddhu with Sneha and confronts her.

episodesList.title: Sneha learns of Siddhu's fiance
episodesList.summary: Purvi confronts Sneha and reveals that she is Siddhu’s fiancee. Soon, Sarla plans to hasten Siddhu’s wedding. Ganga seeks Manohar’s help, while Vimla alerts Durgawati about her son’s arrest.

episodesList.title: An engagement under duress
episodesList.summary: Manohar pressures Ganga to hand over her property and she makes a promise. Vimla delivers a shocking news to Sneha. Purvi arrives in a palanquin and Sarla demands Durgawati to arrange her engagement.

episodesList.title: Sneha urges Shekar to identify the prisoner
episodesList.summary: Sneha calls Shekhar to the police station to identify the prisoner. Indu congratulates Sahana and hints at Ganga’s promise. Soni asks Sahana to confide in Ganga about her feelings for Murli.

episodesList.title: Murli leaves a note for Sahana
episodesList.summary: Durgawati’s questions Shekhar about the complainant in exchange for a life with Madhu. Sneha misreads Murli’s note for Sahana as Sahib's, which soon lands in Siddhu’s hands, leading him to Murli.

episodesList.title: Madhu goes missing
episodesList.summary: Murli learns about Ganga arranging a match for Sahana. Siddhu tries to dissuade Purvi from marrying him, sparking her anger for Sneha. Later, Madhu’s disappearance creates chaos.

episodesList.title: Sneha locates Madhu
episodesList.summary: Sneha finds Madhu and alerts Siddhu. Later, Sneha confronts Indu for troubling Ganga. Afterwards, Sneha meets Madhu again, while Siddhu hides his identity from her.

episodesList.title: Shekar learns of Siddhu's love
episodesList.summary: Siddhu tells Shekhar about his feelings for Sneha. Shekhar demands that he reveal his identity to Sneha within 10 days. Later, Kali resolves to foil Sahana’s alliance and make her his bride.

episodesList.title: Kali gets Sneha kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Siddhu requests Purvi to call off their alliance. Meanwhile, a prospective suitor and his family come to meet Sahana. Later, Kali gets Sneha kidnapped and plans to elope with Sahana.

episodesList.title: Kali's act invokes Ganga's anger
episodesList.summary: Siddhu is alerted about Sneha’s kidnap and goes to save her. Meanwhile, Kali tries to apply vermilion to Sahana’s forehead, but an enraged Ganga throws him out and destroys his bar.

episodesList.title: Sneha's fierce stand gets Kali arrested
episodesList.summary: Ganga wins praise for shutting Kali’s brewery, yet Sahana’s alliance is refused. Siddhu rescues Sneha, who thrashes Kali and his goons, and the united villagers force the police to arrest him.

episodesList.title: Murli's parents interrupt his celebration
episodesList.summary: Sneha thanks Siddhu for saving her life. Murli celebrates Sahana’s rejected match but is caught by his disapproving parents. Indu then threatens Ganga, but her daughters lift her spirits with a dance.

episodesList.title: Sneha regrets straining Madhu's marriage
episodesList.summary: Sneha finds Siddhu asleep outside the eatery. He confesses his love but wakes up to realise it was a dream. Kali calls out Manohar's betrayal. Sneha regrets straining Madhu and Shekhar’s relationship.

episodesList.title: Sneha plans to reveal herself as the complainant
episodesList.summary: Sahana drops a tiffin at Murli’s home, and he lies to his parents. Sneha goes to meet Durgawati, planning to reveal herself as the complainant. Purvi continues pursuing Siddhu despite his rejection.

episodesList.title: Siddhu to confide in Sneha
episodesList.summary: Soni’s questions about hidden trophies unsettle Ganga. Durgawati invites her to Siddhu’s engagement, only to be surprised by Ganga’s offer. Siddhu calls Sneha to the temple to confess the truth.

episodesList.title: An unlikely alliance joins Soni's protest
episodesList.summary: Madhu discourages Sneha from coming clean about the complaint. Indu learns about Murli's feelings for Sahana and plans to use it against Ganga. At the college, an unlikely ally joins Soni's protest.

episodesList.title: Indu and Kali plot Sahana's fall
episodesList.summary: Siddhu rejects Purvi and vows to wed Sneha. At the temple, Kali blocks Sahana as Indu sways Murli’s mother. Soni’s team skips practice, while Ganga fears Durgawati and Sneha may clash.

episodesList.title: Sneha's bold confession to Durgavati
episodesList.summary: To halt Durgawati’s clash with Vimla, Sneha confesses Siddhu’s arrest, pleasing Purvi. Murli plans Sahana’s meeting with his parents at college, but Paras and Soni’s fight with some boys sparks chaos.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Siddhu at odds
episodesList.summary: Sneha washes the vermilion from her hair parting as Siddhu watches. Purvi confronts him about Sneha and Durgawati. Later, fate pits Siddhu and Sneha against each other in a kite contest.

episodesList.title: Soni meets her coach
episodesList.summary: During the kite contest, Kali confesses his feelings to Sahana. Durgawati catches Siddhu with a kite bearing a love note, and Kali notices his tattoo. Soni and her team finally meet their coach.

episodesList.title: Sneha is furious
episodesList.summary: Ganga recalls sacrificing her sporting dreams, now revived by Soni. Murli rejects an arranged match to wed Sahana. Indu plots against Sneha, who wrongly lashes out at Siddhu over defamatory posters.

episodesList.title: Siddhu makes a promise
episodesList.summary: Angered by the poster, Sneha slaps Siddhu and returns home distraught. Siddhu makes a promise to Ganga and reassures her. Durgawati sees the poster and misunderstands Sneha as Purvi instigates her.

episodesList.title: Ganga receives a startling call
episodesList.summary: Siddhu vows to expose the poster conspiracy within 24 hours. Influenced by Indu’s slander against Sneha, Murli’s parents refuse to meet Ganga, who later receives a startling call.

episodesList.title: Sneha acknowledges her feelings for Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Kali’s aide exposes the motive behind the defamatory posters against Sneha. Later, a dream of Siddhu and Soni’s teasing prompt Sneha to finally acknowledge her feelings for him.

episodesList.title: Sneha reads murli's letter for Sahana
episodesList.summary: Siddhu regains consciousness and questions Sneha. Later, Sneha reads Murli’s note meant for Sahana. Elsewhere, Durgawati prepares for Siddhu’s engagement, forcing him to decide to reveal the truth.

episodesList.title: Siddhu refuses to marry Purvi
episodesList.summary: Siddhu refuses to marry Purvi, but Durgawati does not relent. Indu provokes Ganga and corners Soni. As Sneha heads to the temple wearing Siddhu’s gifted saree, fate draws Siddhu and Purvi there too.

episodesList.title: A priest blesses Sneha and Siddhu
episodesList.summary: At the temple, Murli urges Sahana to elope with him, but she refuses for Ganga’s sake. A priest mistakes Sneha for Purvi and blesses her with Siddhu, just as Purvi arrives at the shrine.

episodesList.title: Siddhu speaks in Murli's defence
episodesList.summary: At the temple, watching Sneha with Siddhu fuels Purvi’s anger and Durgawati’s mistaken joy. Later, Siddhu defends Murli in front of Sneha and Purvi resolves to ruin Siddhu's love story.

episodesList.title: Sneha challenges Purvi
episodesList.summary: Purvi insults Ganga’s food and accepts Sneha’s challenge for the feast. Murli’s parents raise a ruckus at the eatery. Later, Murli’s confession is blocked as Sneha threatens to summon the police.

episodesList.title: Purvi waits for Sneha
episodesList.summary: Sneha scolds Siddhu for backing Murli, who drops his plan to marry Sahana, while Indu and Kali plot to halt her engagement. Later, Purvi awaits Sneha at her engagement with Siddhu for a fiery outcome.

episodesList.title: Siddhu breaks his silence
episodesList.summary: Ganga’s words empower a man to convince his mother to accept his girl child. Before his engagement, Siddhu tells his father that he doesn’t like Purvi, while she tricks Sneha into coming there.

episodesList.title: Purvi and Sarla plot against Siddhu and Sneha
episodesList.summary: Purvi and Sarla plot to bring Sneha before Durgawati and Siddhu, while Siddhu and Madhu avoid trouble. Meanwhile, Kaushalya’s trick compels Murli to agree to meet a prospective bride.

episodesList.title: Siddhu and Purvi's Ring ceremony
episodesList.summary: Despite being locked in Madhu's washroom, Sneha manages to ruin Purvi's plan. As the ring ceremony takes place, Sneha leaves Madhu's room, setting stage for a devastating confrontation.

episodesList.title: A startling confession comes to light
episodesList.summary: Sneha confronts Siddhu at Durgawati's mansion. Back home, Ganga earns praise as a coach and wins Soni over. Manohar warns Soni of Kali’s plan, and Sneha overhears a startling confession.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's trick to help Murli
episodesList.summary: Sneha realises Siddhu was right that Sahana loves Murli. While Siddhu plots to stop Murli’s family from visiting a match, Kali sets a trap for Sahana’s suitor. Vimla sees Shekhar and Madhu's fight.

episodesList.title: Murli arrives with his family to meet Ganga
episodesList.summary: Indu celebrates as the family of Sahana’s prospective groom fails to arrive. Murli arrives with his family and declares his love for Sahana. Ganga then urges them to accept the children’s choice.

episodesList.title: Durgavati meets Murli's parents
episodesList.summary: Sahana is heartbroken when Murli’s father refuses to bless her. Durgawati steps in, praises Ganga and urges Murli’s parents to reconsider. Sneha and Siddhu reconcile, unaware they are being watched.

episodesList.title: An unlikely ally for Indu
episodesList.summary: Purvi is determined to confront Durgawati over Siddhu and Sneha. Vimla presses Shekhar to send Madhu a divorce notice. Indu plots to burn Ganga’s eatery and finds an unlikely ally.

episodesList.title: Indu meets Murli's parents
episodesList.summary: Sneha asks Poojari to abduct her in an effort to meet Sahib. Later, Indu goes to Murli’s house and tarnishes Sahana’s image. Ganga trains the Kho-Kho team for their upcoming tournament.

episodesList.title: Murli's sister makes a promise
episodesList.summary: Murli’s sister vows to secure his marriage to Sahana. Murli uncovers Sneha’s abduction plan and stays back to protect her. Kali targets the eatery and Poojari’s gang clashes with his men.

episodesList.title: Siddhu is critically injured
episodesList.summary: Kali’s aide attacks Siddhu, leaving him critically injured. Durgawati vows revenge as Indu plots to seize the eatery. Guilt haunts Sneha, who learns Siddhu is at Durgawati’s mansion.

episodesList.title: Ganga is humiliated at the tournament
episodesList.summary: Sneha leaves for Prayagraj as the team departs for the tournament. Siddhu wakes, learns of her concern, defies Durgawati and secretly meets her. Meanwhile, Ganga faces humiliation at the venue.

episodesList.title: Kali sabotages the tournament
episodesList.summary: St Mary’s win the toss, unsettling Soni, and Ganga inspires her to play barefoot. As her team excels, Indu has Kali spike their water, and the players collapse mid-match.

episodesList.title: Soni dedicated her trophy to Ganga
episodesList.summary: Soni and her team lift the Kho Kho trophy, crediting Ganga’s miracle moves. Indu alerts Purvi about Siddhu, who soon uses it to provoke Durgawati.

episodesList.title: Sneha sees Siddhu's tattoo
episodesList.summary: At the hospital, Sneha notices Siddhu’s tattoo during his sponge bath and realises he concealed being Sahib to mislead her. Moments later, Durgawati turns up with Purvi and Madhu.

episodesList.title: Indu uses Murli's parents to insult Ganga
episodesList.summary: Sneha is torn by Siddhu’s lie, sensing love behind his hidden truth. After she and Soni celebrate their win, a furious Indu ensures Ganga is insulted by Murli’s parents over the alliance.

episodesList.title: Murli asks for Sahana's hand in marriage
episodesList.summary: Insulted by Kaushalya, Ganga seeks Manohar’s help for Sahana’s marriage talks but is refused. She returns home to scold Sneha, while Murli seeks her consent to marry Sahana as Siddhu overhears.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya and Indu's evil plot
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya joins hands with Indu and gives her consent for Murli and Sahana’s alliance with an ulterior motive. Unaware of their plan, Ganga blesses the union as Sahana and Murli express their joy.

episodesList.title: Sneha reaches out to Sahib
episodesList.summary: Siddhu arrives during Murli and Sahana’s celebration as Purvi mistakes his feelings. Sneha confides in Soni that Siddhu is Sahib and messages him to meet, leaving Siddhu panicked about facing her.

episodesList.title: Indu's plan to cancel Sahana's wedding
episodesList.summary: As per Indu’s plan, Kaushalya tells Ganga that the wedding will stand cancelled if Manohar doesn’t attend it. Meanwhile, Indu instigates Manohar to give the wedding a miss.

episodesList.title: Indu's retribution to Ganga
episodesList.summary: Sahana’s wedding is threatened when Indu demands a humiliating apology from Ganga to allow Manohar’s presence. Just as Ganga is about to comply, Sahana stops her, choosing dignity over the alliance.

episodesList.title: Is Sneha falling for Siddhu
episodesList.summary: When Siddhu learns of Indu’s demand, he speaks to Durgawati, who later warns Indu sharply against bothering Ganga. Meanwhile, Soni’s teasing remark prompts Sneha to reflect on her feelings for Siddu.

episodesList.title: Murli lies to Ganga and her family
episodesList.summary: Indu targets Purvi to get back at Sneha. Murli lies to Ganga and Sahana saying that Manohar’s absence will not be an issue at the wedding. Later, Kaushalya’s indirect dowry demands bother Ganga.

episodesList.title: Siddhu to test Sneha's feelings
episodesList.summary: Siddhu realises that Sneha knows he is Sahib and decides to test her feelings. Meanwhile, Purvi’s misunderstanding grows deeper. Later, Siddhu heads to the dhaba to meet Sneha.

episodesList.title: Sneha's heart breaks at Siddhu's words
episodesList.summary: Siddhu plans to profess his love and reveal his truth to Sneha, only to hurt her by calling her a friend. Meanwhile, Murli celebrates Valentine’s Day with Sahana as Ganga faces new pressures.

episodesList.title: A love confession amidst conspiracy
episodesList.summary: As Siddhu prepares to declare his love for Sneha during the celebrations of MahaShivratri and seeks the lord’s blessings, Indu plots a conspiracy to seek revenge against Sneha.

episodesList.title: Will Sneha finally learn Siddhu's feelings
episodesList.summary: Siddhu excitedly shows Sneha the surprises he planned for his lover, and she eagerly waits to hear her name. Indu sends Purvi his location. Later, Siddhu almost confesses his love to Sneha.

episodesList.title: Siddhu and Sneha confess their love to each other
episodesList.summary: Siddhu and Sneha confess their love as a shocked Purvi watches. Indu fuels Purvi’s desire for revenge using Durgawati, who refuses to let Siddhu fall for anyone.

episodesList.title: Siddhu tries to stop Madhu's divorce
episodesList.summary: Sneha and Siddhu share their love confessions with their close ones. However, Siddhu returns home to find Madhu signing the divorce papers, and he rushes to stop her and Durgawati.

episodesList.title: Indu tries to instigate Durgavati against Siddhu
episodesList.summary: While talking to Sneha, Siddhu gets an idea to reunite Shekhar and Madhu. The next morning, preparations for Sahana’s engagement are underway, while Indu tries to instigate Durgawati against Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya's demand worries Ganga
episodesList.summary: Siddhu and Madhu arrive to help Ganga and her family. Kaushalya’s demand for hefty gifts worries Ganga, and Sneha becomes suspicious. Later, Vimla’s words spark an argument between Madhu and Shekhar.

episodesList.title: Indu and kali's plot to ruin Sahana's engagement
episodesList.summary: Shekhar warns Sneha about Siddhu and walks away. The time for the engagement nears and Ganga worries about Manohar’s absence. Meanwhile, Indu and Kali plot to secure Sahana’s alliance for the latter.

episodesList.title: Sneha outsmarts Kaushalya's chaos
episodesList.summary: In cahoots with Indu, Kaushalya warns that the engagement will be cancelled if Manohar does not attend it. Siddhu stops Sneha from reacting, and she devises a plan, asking Kaushalya for an hour.

episodesList.title: Sahana and Murli get engaged
episodesList.summary: With Paras’ help, Sneha traps Indu into attending Sahana and Murli’s engagement with Manohar. Kaushalya gets angry at Indu for foiling their plan. Later, Sahana and Murli get engaged.

episodesList.title: Indu and Purvi plot to expose Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Sahana refuses to speak to Murli after his lie. Siddhu stops Durgawati from coming to Ganga’s home. Indu and Purvi plot to expose Siddhu and Sneha, while Kaushalya confronts Indu for foiling her plan.

episodesList.title: Durgavati sees Sneha with Siddhu
episodesList.summary: As Siddhu spends time with Sneha, Purvi cunningly video‑calls Durgawati, exposing them. While Indu shares her plan with Kali, Vimla’s condition for attending Sahana’s wedding puts Ganga in a fix.

episodesList.title: Durgawati grows suspicious of Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Purvi and Indu plot to ruin Siddhu and Sneha’s relationship. Durgawati grows suspicious of Siddhu, but Siddhu allays her fears. Meanwhile, Sahana grows worried about her future with Murli.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya harasses ganga with dowry demands
episodesList.summary: At Indu’s instigation, Kaushalya and her husband indirectly demand a hefty dowry from Ganga. Ganga hesitates but promises to do her best. Things go overboard when Murli’s parents demand a car.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's tricks to avoid being exposed
episodesList.summary: Durgawati finds Ganga fainting across the street and takes her home, promising secrecy. To avoid being exposed, Siddhu gets Durgawati to slap him, but Sneha fumes, mistaking it for mistreatment.

episodesList.title: Ganga's realisation about the dowry
episodesList.summary: Sneha convinces a woman that dowry won’t save her daughter, making Ganga drop Kaushalya’s demands. But after Murli’s words sway her again, Sneha overhears Ganga confessing it to Shanta.

episodesList.title: Purvi takes a photo of Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Ganga begins handing out wedding invitations, while Sneha goes shopping with Sahana and Soni. At Indu's behest, Purvi snaps their photo to expose Siddhu, as Murli's brother‑in‑law plots against him.

episodesList.title: Durgavati falls for Purvi's trap
episodesList.summary: Purvi fuels Durgawati’s doubt with a planted receipt as Siddhu hides a gift for Sneha. Murli’s apology wins Sahana’s forgiveness, while Ganga seeks an INR 15‑lakh loan for dowry, risking her property.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya's warning to Ganga
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise as Purvi sparks fresh doubt about Siddhu. Meanwhile, Kaushalya issues a chilling ultimatum to provide the dowry or Sahana’s wedding will be cancelled.

episodesList.title: Siddhu hides from Vimla
episodesList.summary: Siddhu tries to hide from Vimla during Sahana’s mehendi ceremony. Later, Siddhu and Sneha share a romantic moment as a disguised Kali crashes the ceremony.

episodesList.title: Manoj's friend tries to molest Soni
episodesList.summary: A friend of Manoj tries to molest Soni, but Siddhu intervenes and beats him. Manoj defends his friend and demands an apology or he will cancel the wedding. Manohar apologises, angering Indu.

episodesList.title: Siddhu punishes Soni's harasser
episodesList.summary: Siddhu mentors Soni and punishes her harasser. Indu strikes Paras during a dispute over Ganga's family. Thereafter, Ganga secures the wedding funds, while Indu vows to ruin her life.

episodesList.title: Will Durgavati find out about Siddhu and Sneha's relationship?
episodesList.summary: When Ghanshyam refuses to give a loan to Ganga, Durgawati selflessly extends financial help to her for Sahana’s wedding. Later, Durgawati is shocked to see Siddhu and Sneha playing Holi together.

episodesList.title: Purvi drugs Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Durgawati arrives with Ganga at the dhaba as a disguised Purvi feeds a bhang-laced sweet to Siddhu. Later, Durgawati is prevented from learning the name of the girl Siddhu loves.

episodesList.title: Sneha confronts Ganga about the dowry money
episodesList.summary: Durgawati comes to Ganga’s house and assumes Sneha brought Madhu and Shekhar so Vimla could insult Madhu. Later, Sneha finds money and asks Ganga if Durgawati gave it and if Kaushalya demanded dowry.

episodesList.title: Indu's plan to expose Siddhu and Sneha's affair
episodesList.summary: Indu and Purvi find a video on Purvi’s phone and plan to expose Siddhu and Sneha’s affair. Amid Sahana and Murli’s Haldi celebrations, Indu calls Durgawati anonymously and tries to manipulate her.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya returns the dowry money to Ganga
episodesList.summary: Ganga gives the dowry money to Kaushalya ahead of Sahana’s wedding, which Kaushalya publicly returns when Soni goes to expose her. Later, Indu locks Manohar in the house.

episodesList.title: Indu demands the unthinkable
episodesList.summary: Indu demands Ganga’s dhaba and home in return for Manohar’s presence at Sahana’s wedding. Ganga signs the property transfer papers, while Kaushalya raises a ruckus over Manohar’s absence.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Siddhu bring Manohar to the wedding
episodesList.summary: Sneha and Siddhu rescue Manohar and bring him to Sahana’s wedding. Kaushalya is enraged but Kusum convinces her to let the wedding continue. Later, Indu prepares to publicly humiliate Sneha.

episodesList.title: Durgavati watches Siddhu and Sneha's video
episodesList.summary: As Sahana and Murli’s wedding concludes, Indu covertly makes Durgawati watch a video footage of Siddhu and Sneha. A furious Kali tries to create a scene during Sahana's vidaai, but Siddhu stops him.

episodesList.title: Durgavati's resolve
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya reluctantly performs Sahana’s ‘griha pravesh’ and interrupts her and Murli’s wedding night. Meanwhile, Durgawati resolves to separate Siddhu from the girl who has trapped him.

episodesList.title: Sahana's Pagphera and the secret
episodesList.summary: Sneha tells Siddhu she’ll reveal their affair to Ganga only after her IAS exams, and he agrees. They head to Murli’s house for Sahana’s 'pagphera', while Indu plots to usurp Ganga’s property.

episodesList.title: Kaushalya's plot and Indu's bulldozer
episodesList.summary: Sneha tries to convince Kaushalya to allow Sahana’s ‘pagphera’ while Ganga fears losing her home. Indu arrives with a bulldozer, and Sneha and Siddhu confront her as Bhairav keeps a watch on Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Durgavati come face to face
episodesList.summary: Siddhu discreetly brings Sneha and Durgawati face-to-face, but the duo ends up insulting each other. Bhairav snaps a photo of Siddhu with Sneha, while Kaushalya plots against Sahana.

episodesList.title: Sneha meets a mystery man
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya holds Sahana back as Murli heads to the city to resume his job. Vimla assumes that Madhu is carrying someone else’s child and prepares to expose her. Meanwhile, Sneha meets a mystery man.

episodesList.title: Shantanu offers Ganga a job
episodesList.summary: The mystery man introduces himself as Shantanu Shukla and offers Ganga a high-paying job at his Lucknow hotel to turn around its losses. Ganga rejects his offer, while Madhu’s innocence is proved.

episodesList.title: Ganga agrees to help Shantanu
episodesList.summary: At Siddhu’s urging, everyone backs Ganga, leading her to agree to visit Shantanu’s hotel to help him. But Indu informs Kaushalya, who demands more dowry, while Durgawati pushes Madhu towards divorce.

episodesList.title: Durgavati faces a shocking sight
episodesList.summary: Siddhu helps Sneha and Ganga travel to Shantanu’s hotel, where Ganga meets Om Prakash. Murli worries about Sahana, while Durgawati, after seeing Sneha with Siddhu, accuses Vimla of trapping him.

episodesList.title: Ganga's silly food errors shock everyone
episodesList.summary: Shantanu introduces Ganga and Sneha to Chef Vicky, but silly food errors later shock Bansi and Om Prakash. Meanwhile, Durgawati readies Madhu’s divorce papers, and Murli’s visit irks Kaushalya.

episodesList.title: Sneha restores Ganga's lost courage
episodesList.summary: Ganga falters, but Sneha restores her confidence. Meanwhile, Vimla searches for proof of Sneha and Siddhu’s affair as drama erupts at Murli’s home. Later, Shantanu prepares Ganga for Bhaskar’s review.

episodesList.title: Ganga impresses Bhaskar with her culinary skills
episodesList.summary: Siddhu supports Ganga before Bhaskar’s review. Mocked for her lack of training, she rises with Sneha’s faith and Shantanu’s guidance, impressing Bhaskar with exotic dishes.

episodesList.title: A celebration for Ganga's win
episodesList.summary: A rival chef hides Ganga’s ingredient, but Sneha saves the day. Ganga impresses Bhaskar, and her dhaba gains fame, irking Indu. Later, the villagers and Shantanu celebrate Ganga’s triumph.

episodesList.title: Ganga suspects Sneha's feelings
episodesList.summary: Siddhu grows restless on seeing Shantanu conversing with Sneha. Ganga suspects that Sneha is in love with someone. Meanwhile, Kaushalya plots to humiliate Sahana in front of Payal and Rajiv.

episodesList.title: Shekar gets into an accident
episodesList.summary: Durgawati confides in Ganga about her son’s affair. Shekhar gets into an accident on his way to the court for the divorce hearing and Madhu, Sneha and Siddhu tend to him.

episodesList.title: Durgavati uncovers painful lies
episodesList.summary: Vimla storms in with the police, accusing Durgawati of abducting Shekhar. Siddhu secretly helps Sneha take Shekhar away, adding to Durgawati’s rage. Meanwhile, Shantanu calls Soni to speak with Ganga.

episodesList.title: Ganga learns about Siddhu and Sneha
episodesList.summary: Shekhar decides to separate Siddhu and Sneha, while Durgawati instructs Bhairav to abduct Sneha. Ganga learns about Sneha and Siddhu’s affair, while Murli comes to Sahana’s rescue.

episodesList.title: Danger looms on Sneha and Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Ganga lets Siddhu accompany Sneha to Lucknow. Unseen threats loom as Kali boards the train to kill Siddhu, while Bhairav and his gang plan to kidnap Sneha.

episodesList.title: Siddhu and Sneha under attack
episodesList.summary: Shekhar comes clean to Durgawati about Siddhu and Sneha’s relationship. Meanwhile, Siddhu battles the masked attackers, as Bhairav’s goons render Sneha unconscious.

episodesList.title: Durgavati learns that Sneha is Ganga's daughter
episodesList.summary: Ganga tells Durgawati that Sneha is her daughter. Durgawati orders her goons to not kidnap Sneha, but a masked Kali accuses her when caught by Siddhu. Ganga learns that Siddhu is Durgawati’s son.

episodesList.title: Ganga and Durgavati's vow
episodesList.summary: Ganga and Durgawati vow to separate Siddhu and Sneha as Siddhu’s health suddenly deteriorates and he collapses. Meanwhile, Indu continues her plotting against Siddhu, Sneha and their families.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's rushed wedding plans
episodesList.summary: Sahana exposes Kaushalya’s secret dowry, while Ganga’s hidden promise worries Sneha and Siddhu after Shantanu drives them home. Elsewhere, Durgawati hastens Siddhu’s marriage to Purvi, pleasing Indu

episodesList.title: Sneha's shares her feelings with Ganga
episodesList.summary: Indu is hurt while bravely stopping a goon who steals Durgawati’s necklace, and Durgawati takes her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Sneha tells Ganga that she loves Siddhu, shattering Ganga emotionally.

episodesList.title: Ganga opposes Sneha and Siddhu's alliance
episodesList.summary: Ganga bars Sneha from marrying Siddhu, branding him unworthy. Siddhu confides in Madhu about the attack on him, while Indu aids Kaushalya’s plot against Sahana’s marriage.

episodesList.title: Ganga's disappearance worries Sneha
episodesList.summary: Sneha grows restless when Ganga fails to return home overnight. The next day, Durgawati questions Ganga at the temple about Sneha and Siddhu, while Kali's call helps Kaushalya malign Sahana.

episodesList.title: Ganga forces Sneha to make a painful choice
episodesList.summary: At Ganga's behest, Sneha hides the truth from Siddhu, who leaves hopeful about their marriage. Later, he closes in on Bhairav as Durgawati orders him to find who is behind the attack on Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha avoids Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Siddhu reconciles with Durgawati, while Ganga forces Sneha to cut ties with him. Later, Sneha avoids Siddhu and leaves to help Shantanu with his new business venture.

episodesList.title: Kali storms into Murli's house
episodesList.summary: Angry at Kaushalya’s mistreatment of Sahana, Kali storms into Murli’s House. Meanwhile, Siddhu is hurt by Sneha’s avoidance, as Durgawati blames her for prolonging the breakup.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's confession to Durgavati
episodesList.summary: A land dispute pits Durgawati against Shantanu, who is supported by Sneha, deepening tensions. Later, Siddhu meets with Durgawati and confesses that he is in love with Sneha.

episodesList.title: Sneha's cold silence hurts Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Hoping Ganga keeps her promise, Durgawati pretends to accept Sneha. Murli’s visit with Sahana brings cheer. Sneha’s refusal to go with Siddhu hurts him as he seeks to discuss their alliance.

episodesList.title: Sneha cuts ties with Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Sneha decides to talk to Siddhu at Soni’s urging, while Shanta tells Sahana about Ganga giving dowry to Murli’s parents. Later, Sneha breaks-up with Siddhu, calling him unworthy of her.

episodesList.title: Sneha tops her mock test
episodesList.summary: Soni confronts Sneha for leaving Siddhu, but Ganga silences her, deepening suspicions. Amidst guilt and heartbreak, Sneha tops her mock test and longs to celebrate her victory with Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha rejects Siddhu's gift
episodesList.summary: Shantanu celebrates Sneha’s success, leaving Siddhu heartbroken. Sneha rejects Siddhu’s gift, deepening his pain. Ganga urges Durgawati to help him heal, while Indu’s arrival spells trouble.

episodesList.title: Durgavati pretends to support Siddhu
episodesList.summary: Indu threatens to expose Sneha, while Durgawati pretends to support Siddhu’s love. A reunion plan at a school event backfires when Siddhu sees Sneha with Shantanu and Durgawati learns about it.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's confession angers Ganga
episodesList.summary: Siddhu’s powerful speech earns praise, but his love confession angers Ganga. As he grieves, Ganga takes charge against the LPG crisis and goes to confront Indu for hoarding cylinders.

episodesList.title: Ganga builds a communal stove
episodesList.summary: Indu evades charges of LPG hoarding, but Ganga builds a communal clay stove to help villagers. As Indu plots revenge, a grieving Siddhu unexpectedly spots her scheme.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's pain shatters Sneha
episodesList.summary: While Siddhu repairs Ganga's clay stove, Sneha secretly helps him, moved by his plight. Meanwhile, Kaushalya’s scheme pays off as Murli declares she’ll come home with him and Sahana.

episodesList.title: Ganga's warning to Vimla
episodesList.summary: Siddhu declares breaking his fast after seeing Sneha’s face. Ganga warns Vimla against using Sneha in her fight with Durgawati. Meanwhile, Indu plots the destruction of Ganga’s communal stove.

episodesList.title: Ganga decides to get Sneha married
episodesList.summary: Durgawati struggles with Siddhu’s anger and his love for Sneha. Ganga decides that Sneha’s marriage may help him move on, as Siddhu later seeks forgiveness from his mother.

episodesList.title: Vimla's revelation to Siddhu
episodesList.summary: A tearful Sneha tells Ganga that she won’t get married. Shantanu admits his feelings for her to Shekhar, while Vimla shocks Siddhu by revealing that Durgawati caused his breakup.

episodesList.title: Shantanu proposes to Sneha
episodesList.summary: Vimla hints that Durgawati caused Siddhu’s breakup. With Ganga’s blessing, Shantanu proposes to Sneha at the temple, unaware Siddhu is also there, while Kaushalya intensifies her plot against Sahana.

episodesList.title: Ganga pushes Sneha to accept Shantanu
episodesList.summary: OP Shukla meets Ganga and seeks Sneha’s hand in marriage for Shantanu, while Siddhu hopes of a reconciliation with Sneha. Later, Ganga urges Sneha to accept Shantanu’s proposal.

episodesList.title: Siddhu attends Shantanu's pooja
episodesList.summary: Shantanu assures Sneha he will wait for her response to his marriage proposal and invites her family to a puja. Later, Vimla instigates Siddhu, prompting him to arrive there to demand answers.

episodesList.title: Sneha's shocking announcement
episodesList.summary: Siddhu, disguised as a waiter, meets Sneha and asks if she truly wants to marry Shantanu. Meanwhile, Ganga reveals details of Shantanu’s proposal to Sneha. Later, Sneha makes a shocking announcement.

episodesList.title: Sneha accepts Shantanu's proposal
episodesList.summary: Sneha breaks Siddhu’s heart by accepting Shantanu’s marriage proposal, hoping that Siddhu moves on from her. As Ganga performs the duo’s ‘tilak ceremony’, Murli learns about Siddhu’s parentage.

episodesList.title: Shantanu is kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Shantanu gets kidnapped, and Siddhu comes under suspicion for it. Hoping to save Sneha from betrayal, Shekhar urges Murli to contact Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Shantanu's engagement is fixed
episodesList.summary: Sneha accuses Siddhu of abducting Shantanu, only to learn Siddhu actually saved him. While her engagement is fixed, Siddhu doubts Shantanu’s past and vows to uncover the truth.

episodesList.title: Siddhu learns about Shantanu's past
episodesList.summary: Kaushalya plots with Indu to cancel Sneha and Shantanu’s alliance and for Sahana to take the blame for it. Meanwhile, Siddhu learns that Shantanu was involved in an illegal trade.

episodesList.title: Siddhu wants to meet Sneha
episodesList.summary: As Sneha prepares for her engagement with Shantanu, Indu and Kaushalya plot against Sahana. Later, a desperate call from Siddhu urges Sneha to meet him before the ceremony so he could expose Shantanu.

episodesList.title: Shantanu and Sneha are engaged
episodesList.summary: Siddhu reveals Shantanu’s past to Sneha. On the other hand, Shantanu confides in Ganga about his past and seeks a second chance. Believing him, Ganga convinces Sneha, and the duo gets engaged.

episodesList.title: Siddhu gets engaged to Purvi
episodesList.summary: Indu’s veiled threat at Sneha’s engagement unsettles Ganga. As Siddhu and Purvi get engaged and the wedding date is set, fate intervenes when the priest suggests the same date for Sneha and Shantanu.

episodesList.title: Indu tries to instigate OP Shukla against Sneha
episodesList.summary: Sahana, Soni and Paras plot to find out the identity of Indu’s spy. Ganga breaks the news of Siddhu’s engagement to Sneha. Later, Indu meets OP Shukla and tries to instigate him against Sneha.

episodesList.title: Indu lays a trap for Sneha
episodesList.summary: Indu lures Sneha away with a fake suicide threat about Siddhu. As Shantanu expresses his trust in Sneha and Kaushalya is exposed, Sneha walks into Indu’s trap and is attacked.

episodesList.title: Indu traps Sneha and Siddhu in a room
episodesList.summary: Siddhu finds an unconscious Sneha in the hut. Indu locks them both inside and renders Siddhu unconscious as well. While Indu leaves to help Kaushalya, Sneha awakens and tries to rouse Siddhu.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Siddhu are caught in Indu's trap
episodesList.summary: Trapped together, Sneha and Siddhu sense a plot against them and struggle to break free. Ganga nearly reaches Sneha, but Indu knocks her out and brings Shantanu and his father to the scene.

episodesList.title: Sneha and Siddhu evade suspicion
episodesList.summary: Sneha rescues Siddhu from the hut as Indu’s trap unfolds. Ganga evades suspicion to protect them, while Kaushalya’s truth shocks Sahana. Siddhu exposes the conspiracy and captures Shambhu.

episodesList.title: Indu gets arrested
episodesList.summary: Sneha and Ganga boldly expose Indu’s conspiracy, leading to her arrest. While Siddhu and Shantanu admire Sneha’s courage, hidden tensions rise as Purvi and Kaushalya continue their own schemes.

episodesList.title: Indu teams up with Vimla
episodesList.summary: Indu is shocked to discover who secured her bail and soon joins Vimla’s scheme to halt Sneha’s marriage to Shantanu. Amid Siddhu and Purvi’s wedding preparations, Madhu spots something suspicious.

episodesList.title: Siddhu hosts Shantanu's bachelor party
episodesList.summary: Indu plots on learning that Siddhu-Purvi’s and Sneha-Shantanu’s wedding will be held on the same day. Sahana takes a tough decision while Siddhu hosts Shantanu’s bachelor’s party.

episodesList.title: Sahana uncovers Kusum's betrayal
episodesList.summary: Secrets and suspicions deepen as Indu manipulates Purvi and Sahana uncovers Kusum’s betrayal. Despite lingering love, Sneha and Siddhu proceed with their individual pre-wedding rituals.

episodesList.title: Will Pujari expose Durgavati
episodesList.summary: Durgawati unknowingly reveals her role in Sneha and Siddhu’s breakup, but Siddhu misses the truth. As Sahana tries to repay Ganga’s dowry debt, Pujari prepares to expose Durgawati.

episodesList.title: Will Purvi disrupt Sneha's pre-wedding ceremony
episodesList.summary: Siddhu rejects the truth about Durgawati’s hand in his breakup, while fate brings both pre-wedding ceremonies to one venue. As emotions run high, Indu incites Purvi, who storms into Sneha’s ceremony.

episodesList.title: Purvi sets fire to the venue
episodesList.summary: Purvi sets fire at Sneha’s pre-wedding venue, which leaves Ganga trapped in a room. Kaushalya learns of the theft in her house and plans to leave, while Sneha comes across Ganga.

episodesList.title: Siddhu's truth leaves Ganga shaken
episodesList.summary: As Sneha faints while saving Ganga, Siddhu and Shantanu rush there. Purvi panics when Durgawati calls the cops and races to erase CCTV footage. Later, Ganga gets shocked when Siddhu reveals his truth.

episodesList.title: Will Murli support Sahana?
episodesList.summary: As Sahana sets out to repay Durgawati’s debt, Murli’s call leaves her shaken. Vimla overhears Sneha's plan to meet Madhu. When the truth about the theft is exposed, Murli's reaction stuns Sahana.

episodesList.title: Ganga learns of Sahana's theft
episodesList.summary: Murli drags Sahana to Ganga’s house and reveals about her theft, leaving Ganga shaken. Ganga apologises for Sahana’s behaviour while Siddhu’s father meets Sneha at a temple.

episodesList.title: Pujari tells Virendra the truth
episodesList.summary: Madhu discerns the attempt to harm her father. Pujari reveals Durgawati caused Siddhu and Sneha’s breakup, while Sahana confesses Ganga’s debt to Sneha. A secret plan sows doubt in Shantanu’s mind.

episodesList.title: Siddhu asks Shantanu to call off the wedding
episodesList.summary: Siddhu is thrilled to overhear Sneha confess her love. He asks Shantanu to cancel the wedding, but Shantanu refuses. Meanwhile, Madhu probes the link between Purvi's father and Shantanu.

episodesList.title: Siddhu resolves to stop Sneha's wedding

plotHtml:
Set in the spiritual city of Varanasi, Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan follows the inspiring journey of Ganga Mai, a resilient woman who is abandoned by her husband for not bearing a son. Determined to defy social stigma, she raises her three daughters Sahana, Sneha, and Soni with pride, strength, and unwavering love. Ganga earns a living by running a small dhaba and becomes a symbol of courage in her community.
As the daughters grow, each faces her own struggles: Sneha is bold and justice-driven, Sahana shoulders family responsibilities, and young Soni begins to understand the challenges around her. Sneha’s life takes a turn when she crosses paths with Siddhu, a rough but good-hearted man caught between his feelings for her and his powerful mother Durgavati’s ambitions.
tagline: Set in the spiritual city of Varanasi, Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan follows the inspiring journey of Ganga Mai, a resilient woman who is abandoned by her husband for not bearing a son.

title: Good Wife
summary:
Good Wife is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language legal drama television series starring Priyamani, Aari Arujunan, Sampath Raj, Mekha Rajan, Amrutha Srinivasan, and directed by Revathi. The series is a homemaker and former lawyer who, after few years, starts working at a law firm to support her family when her husband gets stuck in a political scandal. It premiered on JioHotstar on 4 July 2025.
The second season of this series is planned to get released by 2026.
plot: The plot revolves around Tarunika, a law school graduate, who is a loving wife and mother who, after quitting her job following marriage. When her husband, Gunaseelan, is arrested for a sex and corruption scandal, she starts working as a junior lawyer at a law firm to support her family and faces courtroom battles and finding her identity in a male-dominated world.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Priyamani as Tarunika Gunaseelan * Sampath Raj as Gunaseelan; Tarunika's husband * Aari Arujunan as Hari Deepak * Mekha Rajan as Lavanya Umashankar * Amrutha Srinivasan as Sneha Merlin

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
It is an adaptation of Robert King and Michelle King's The Good Wife. It is the second Indian remake after the Hindi language The Trial.
The series was announced by Jio Hotstar on June 3, a day ahead of actress Priyamani’s birthday. The series was written by Halitha Shameem. The show has been directed by actress and filmmaker Revathi, who makes her Tamil directorial debut in a limited series with it. Produced by Rajesh Chadha, Mrinalini Jain, Shyam Rathi, Deepak Dhar, Rishi Negi and S. Raj Narayanan under Banijay Asia, Circle Box Entertainment and Paramount Global Content Distribution. The series was music composed by K, while editing by Kishan Kumar Chezhian. Siddharth Ramaswamy served as co-director and cinematographer on the show.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The series stars Priyamani as lead role in his fourth collaboration acted in limited series after The Family Man, His Story and Sarvam Shakthi Mayam. Actor Sampath Raj was cast as Tarunika's husband Gunaseelan, Aari Arujunan was cast as Hari Deepak.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The first poster was released on 3 June 2025 featuring, The poster shows actress Priyamani holding a bunch of court documents and both side her kids, while Sampath Raj is in the background, behind bars, with the rest of the image filled up with newspaper clippings.
The series Teaser was released on 12 June 2025 with the trailer on 26 June announcing the release date of 4 July. The show premiered in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali and Marathi languages on JioHotstar.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text: Harshini SV of The Times of India gave 2.5/5 stars and wrote, "Such layered writing draws you in at times, as does the unusual premise of the legal cases, but you wish these were more than just fleeting moments". Anusha Sundar of OTTplay gave 2.5/5 stars and wrote, "Good Wife may not be with shocking twists and turns and that’s okay. It takes its time to do a slow start, and might have some interesting pockets of story arcs. It is a slow take-off, and (if) seasons to follow up can increase the pace, to make things move faster and interesting, then Good Wife can possibly be a good addition to the Tamil OTT space".

title: Gulmohor
summary:
Gulmohor is a 2025 Bangladeshi mystery-drama web series directed by Syed Ahmed Shawki and produced by Redoan Rony under the banner of Chorki and Film Syndicate. It stars Saswata Chatterjee, Sara Zaker, Intekhab Dinar, Mostafizur Noor Imran, Sushoma Sarkar, Mir Naufel Ashrafi Jisan, Sarika Sabah, Taufiqul Islam Emon, and Mostafa Monwar. It was streaming on Chorki on 15 May 2025.
The web series won the 27th Meril-Prothom Alo Awards at the Critics' Choice award for Best Web Series category and Syed Ahmed Shawki received the Best Director award for the web series.

articleSections.title: Critical response
articleSections.text:
Jannatul Naym Pieal of The Business Standard praised for its immersive direction and authentic storytelling. Despite a familiar plot and the strong ensemble performances particularly Mostafizur Noor Imran's highlighting the series as a grounded socio-political family drama.
Pritha Paramita Nag of Prothom Alo praised Syed Ahmed Shawki's Chorki series Gulmohor for its nuanced exploration of family conflict and partition trauma and the strong technical craft and lead performances by Mostafizur Noor Imran, Sara Zaker and Saswata Chatterjee, concluding that the show provides a fresh narrative despite its deliberate pacing.

title: Gram Chikitsalay
summary: Gram Chikitsalay is an Indian Hindi-language comedy drama television series directed by Rahul Pandey and created by Deepak Kumar Mishra and Arunabh Kumar. Produced by under TVF, it stars Amol Parashar, Anandeshwar Dwivedi and Vinay Pathak. The series premiered on 9 May 2025 on Prime Video.
plot: The young, brilliant, and idealistic Dr. Prabhat takes over a neglected Primary Health Centre in a remote village called Bhatkandi in Jharkhand, determined to bring about much-needed change—only to discover that he must first transform himself before he can transform anything else.
reception:
Abhishek Srivastav writing for The Times of India gave the series 4 out of 5 stars. and said "The series captures, with sharp detail and humour, the everyday workings of the village and its overlap with the under-resourced health facility." Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express awarded the series out of 5 stars and said "The TVF stamp is clear, and the mandate appears to be the same -- give the viewers yet another slice of ruralcore where the clash between city and village is laid out in slow-paced easily digestible chunks." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that " Gram Chikitsalay is barely engaging, bereft as it is of Panchayat’s strong writing and staging. It isn’t enough to surround the outsider hero with insiders who jabber away in vehemently colloquial Hindi and act out capitalised eccentricity."
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India said in his review that "If you reheat a dinner long enough, however, even the original taste begins to fade. Three seasons in, Panchayat itself would finish as the runner-up in a Panchayat-lookalike contest; Gram Chikitsalay is the sort of imitation that would sit in a corner, join the applause, but take the stage only after the contest." Deepa Gahlot of Rediff.com gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said "Even though this season of Gram Chikitsalay is way short of expectations from a TVF production, Amol Parashar's earnestness makes one care enough for him to see where his journey takes him." Santanu Das of Hindustan Times gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that " Gram Chikitsalay suffers from a case of narrative inertia, where the show thinks through every detail but rarely acts upon it with a stricter gaze."
Shweta Keshri of India Today gave 3.5 stars and said that "the show beautifully captures the challenges and hope. It also highlights the real need for a change in the neglected healthcare sector." Shubham Kulkarni of OTT Play gave 2.5 stars and writes that "The Amol Parashar-starrer is a good idea with a beating heart, but that is not all it takes to build a stellar show. The glue to bind multiple plots is missing in Gram Chikitsalay, and that dilutes the impact of this potent story." Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost rated 3/5 stars and said "Gram Chikitsalay resides on its sharp sense of observation. It spoofs the melodrama of the village life Hindi cinema of the 80s was replete with."
Devesh Sharma of Filmfare rated this show 3/5 stars and said "It’s a worthy watch for fans of rural dramas, but one that leaves you wishing it had taken a few more risks."

episodesList.title: Aaya Ram, Gaya Ram
episodesList.summary: Young and bright Dr. Prabhat leaves his father’s well-established city hospital to take up a challenging post at a neglected rural Primary Health Centre. But he quickly realizes that leave alone treating patients, his first obstacle would be to get to the PHC the way to which has been turned into farmland.

episodesList.title: Swayamsevi
episodesList.summary: Prabhat struggles to attract patients to the PHC as he encounters resistance from villagers who prefer the local quack doctor. Things get complicated when he finds out that the PHC medicines are being sold illegally by someone in the PHC.

episodesList.title: Jhootha Sudhir
episodesList.summary: Having treated no patients in two weeks, Prabhat’s troubles mount when he receives vaccines on Nurse Didi’s behalf, hands it over to her son, Sudhir, as she had wanted but Sudhir refuses blatantly that he took it.

episodesList.title: Bharosa
episodesList.summary: As political tensions escalate in Bhatkandi, Prabhat’s involvement in both rival election campaigns threatens his reputation, forcing him to take a stand against corruption while also discovering Sudhir’s mysterious behavior.

episodesList.title: Bohni
episodesList.summary: Prabhat uncovers Sudhir’s disorder and battles against the stigma of mental illness, persuading Nurse Didi to seek treatment for her son, all while navigating the complex dynamics of village politics and healthcare.

episodesList.title: Udhaar Aur Ghoos
episodesList.summary: As PHC patients rise, Prabhat struggles with medicine shortages while Dak Sab grows jealous. The Adarsh PHC Award may save them.

episodesList.title: Mehanga Shaukh
episodesList.summary: Gobind faces bribery to secure his job as Prabhat prepares the PHC for competition, while Dak Sab plots against them.

episodesList.title: Dekha-Dekhi Aur Checking
episodesList.summary: Dak Sab's fake puja lures the PHC staff away before inspection, wrecking their Adarsh PHC Award hopes as the Adarsh PHC jury nears.

episodesList.title: Pakadaua Vivaah
episodesList.summary: As the jury inspects the PHC, Gobind's chaotic marriage falters while Prabhat and Gargi have a face-off at his wedding.

episodesList.title: Daayan
episodesList.summary: While the Adarsh PHC award results are about to be out, Prabhat and Gargi unite to save a mother and child, restoring hope and faith in medicine.
